title: Please read before you even think of booking with VRBO
text: Posting this just to get it out there. Vrbo is the absolute worst company to try and deal with from a customer support aspect. I am getting no resolution from them and now have no choice but to get my story out there anyway I know how. Here's my story:After a flood destroyed our home earlier this month, I had to relocate quickly with my kids — one of whom is autistic. As a single mom, all I wanted was a quiet, safe, private place to help my kids feel stable again.Instead, the rental I booked through VRBO was a disaster. The “stylish private bungalow in an upscale neighbourhood” as the add described it, turned out to be a run-down, noisy home on a major road, with two tenants and the host living in the basement. The space was unsafe — unstable beds that shifted while you slept, peeling floors, flimsy locks, and a security system that beeped loudly every time someone entered or exited any part of the "PRIVATE" home. This was overwhelming for me and I know it would be completely overwhelming for my autistic child.I packed up and left within 48 hours. The host refused any sort of refund on the month long stay, (over $6,000!) and accused me of trying to “scam” them — while taking zero responsibility for the lies in their listing. No empathy. No decency. VRBO customer service did nothing — no resolution, no accountability, no compassion.If you’re a parent, especially one raising an autistic child or dealing with crisis, please think twice before trusting listings on VRBO.And to the host: families deserve better.

name: Corinna
title: Please read before you even think of booking with VRBO
text: Posting this just to get it out there. Vrbo is the absolute worst company to try and deal with from a customer support aspect. As a single mom, all I wanted was a quiet, safe, private place to help my kids feel stable again.Instead, the rental I booked through VRBO was a disaster. The “stylish private bungalow in an upscale neighbourhood” as the add described it, turned out to be a run-down, noisy home on a major road, with two tenants and the host living in the basement. The space was unsafe — unstable beds that shifted while you slept, peeling floors, flimsy locks, and a security system that beeped loudly every time someone entered or exited any part of the "PRIVATE" home. This was overwhelming for me and I know it would be completely overwhelming for my autistic child.I packed up and left within 48 hours. The host refused any sort of refund on the month long stay, (over $6,000!) and accused me of trying to “scam” them — while taking zero responsibility for the lies in their listing. No empathy. No decency. VRBO customer service did nothing — no resolution, no accountability, no compassion.If you’re a parent, especially one raising an autistic child or dealing with crisis, please think twice before trusting listings on VRBO.And to the host: families deserve better.

name: Karen Ginsburg
title: I do not use Just Fly, Voyages a la Carte or Flight Hub
text: I booked my Air Canada tickets using JustFly because they had the lowest fares. I needed to change the first leg of my outbound flight from the US to Japan because of issues happening at Newark Airport. I called Air Canada and was told they were waiving all change fees for flights out of Newark, however they couldn’t make the change because I didn’t book through them. When I tried to contact JustFly, I  was told they would  not connect me to a live agent unless it was 72 hours before departure, which would have been too late to make the change. I tried using their AI chatbot but it was not updated about waiving the change fees and insisted I would have to pay $700 to make a change. When I asked to be connected to a live chat, I was kept on hold for over 2 hours. I was unable to speak to a live representative and the chatbot was not working. By some miracle, after trying over and over for 24 hours, I was finally connected to a live chat, who also was not aware of the changes for Newark passengers but was willing to look into it and reroute me at no charge. As Air Canada had stated.I looked online and saw over 50 1-star reviews for Voyages a la Carte, the company that did the booking through JustFly, all of them saying the same thing I had just experienced. Do not be fooled by their claims that they provide 24 hour support service. They don’t. Or that the AI bot has the same information as a live agent. It doesn’t. This is a terrible company and I will be reporting them to the Better Business Bureau. The discount is not worth it. Buyer beware.

name: Karen Ginsburg
title: I do not use Just Fly, Voyages a la Carte or Flight Hub
text: I booked my Air Canada tickets using JustFly because they had the lowest fares. I needed to change the first leg of my outbound flight from the US to Japan because of issues happening at Newark Airport. I called Air Canada and was told they were waiving all change fees for flights out of Newark, however they couldn’t make the change because I didn’t book through them. When I tried to contact JustFly, I  was told they would  not connect me to a live agent unless it was 72 hours before departure, which would have been too late to make the change. I tried using their AI chatbot but it was not updated about waiving the change fees and insisted I would have to pay $700 to make a change. When I asked to be connected to a live chat, I was kept on hold for over 2 hours. I was unable to speak to a live representative and the chatbot was not working. By some miracle, after trying over and over for 24 hours, I was finally connected to a live chat, who also was not aware of the changes for Newark passengers but was willing to look into it and reroute me at no charge. As Air Canada had stated.I looked online and saw over 50 1-star reviews for Voyages a la Carte, the company that did the booking through JustFly, all of them saying the same thing I had just experienced. Do not be fooled by their claims that they provide 24 hour support service. They don’t. Or that the AI bot has the same information as a live agent. It doesn’t. This is a terrible company and I will be reporting them to the Better Business Bureau. The discount is not worth it. Buyer beware.

When I asked to be connected to a live chat, I was kept on hold for over 2 hours. I was unable to speak to a live representative and the chatbot was not working. By some miracle, after trying over and over for 24 hours, I was finally connected to a live chat, who also was not aware of the changes for Newark passengers but was willing to look into it and reroute me at no charge. As Air Canada had stated.I looked online and saw over 50 1-star reviews for Voyages a la Carte, the company that did the booking through JustFly, all of them saying the same thing I had just experienced. Do not be fooled by their claims that they provide 24 hour support service. They don’t. Or that the AI bot has the same information as a live agent. It doesn’t. This is a terrible company and I will be reporting them to the Better Business Bureau. The discount is not worth it. Buyer beware.

name: Clint Jose
title: False Promises, No Accountability – Regret Using Way.com
text: I used Way.com to reserve a parking spot in San Francisco, hoping to avoid the stress of finding parking in a busy city. I booked and paid in full in advance, got my confirmation, and even contacted customer support before my trip to confirm everything. They reassured me the reservation was valid and that there were no in-and-out privileges.But when I arrived at the location on the day of my reservation, the lot was chained shut. No access, no attendant, no signage, nothing. I waited for a while, tried to see if anyone was around, and then finally contacted Way.com support. After a long wait on the call, their representative confirmed there was an issue with the lot and that they could not provide parking at that time. I was told to go find parking elsewhere—no assistance, no alternative arrangements, nothing.Stranded in the middle of a busy SF street, I had no choice but to use my hotel’s valet service, which was significantly more expensive. I thought at the very least the refund would be straightforward, given that Way.com could not deliver the service I paid for.But instead, what followed was an endless, frustrating back-and-forth with their support team. I provided:A photo of the chained-up lotA transaction charge from the hotelScreenshots of the call log showing my attempts to contact them while I was at the lotThey still denied the refund, saying it wasn’t enough and that I needed to provide check-in and check-out times from the alternate parking (which obviously I didn't bothered to through hotel valet). Even worse, they tried to spin the situation as a “courtesy cancellation” and offered Way Bucks instead of refunding the actual amount to my card.Let me be clear: this was not a cancellation on my part. Way.com failed to provide the paid service, admitted it during a recorded call, and still tried to shift the responsibility onto me. The dismissive tone and refusal to take accountability made the experience even worse.At this point, I’ve lost money, time, and patience—and I’ve made it clear I will never use Way.com again. What should have been a smooth part of my travel turned into an unnecessary ordeal.If you value your time, money, and peace of mind, think twice before trusting Way.com with your plans.

title: False Promises, No Accountability – Regret Using Way.com
text: I used Way.com to reserve a parking spot in San Francisco, hoping to avoid the stress of finding parking in a busy city. I booked and paid in full in advance, got my confirmation, and even contacted customer support before my trip to confirm everything. They reassured me the reservation was valid and that there were no in-and-out privileges.But when I arrived at the location on the day of my reservation, the lot was chained shut. No access, no attendant, no signage, nothing. I waited for a while, tried to see if anyone was around, and then finally contacted Way.com support. After a long wait on the call, their representative confirmed there was an issue with the lot and that they could not provide parking at that time. I was told to go find parking elsewhere—no assistance, no alternative arrangements, nothing.Stranded in the middle of a busy SF street, I had no choice but to use my hotel’s valet service, which was significantly more expensive. I thought at the very least the refund would be straightforward, given that Way.com could not deliver the service I paid for.But instead, what followed was an endless, frustrating back-and-forth with their support team. I provided:A photo of the chained-up lotA transaction charge from the hotelScreenshots of the call log showing my attempts to contact them while I was at the lotThey still denied the refund, saying it wasn’t enough and that I needed to provide check-in and check-out times from the alternate parking (which obviously I didn't bothered to through hotel valet). Even worse, they tried to spin the situation as a “courtesy cancellation” and offered Way Bucks instead of refunding the actual amount to my card.Let me be clear: this was not a cancellation on my part. Way.com failed to provide the paid service, admitted it during a recorded call, and still tried to shift the responsibility onto me. The dismissive tone and refusal to take accountability made the experience even worse.At this point, I’ve lost money, time, and patience—and I’ve made it clear I will never use Way.com again. What should have been a smooth part of my travel turned into an unnecessary ordeal.If you value your time, money, and peace of mind, think twice before trusting Way.com with your plans.

name: Pablo
title: It's a legit website / company. Careful when typing your email though!
text: Be really careful when buying through the website.It IS LEGIT. However, making a typo in your email when booking would probably result on you having no reservation number / confirmation.I had paid for a 2-night stay in Railay Phutawan resort having thought it was their official website (just comparing prices with booking). Did not manage to see the email confirmation, but that happened because it went to my spam. However, when trying to figure out how to contact the company (you can email to legal [at] guestreservations [dot] com) it looks like there could be many problems if something goes wrong.Reading their email response, it seems you might not be able to retrieve your booking confirmation:"The booking confirmation reservation detail forwarded by email is the only payment receipt available for your reservation. [...] The booking confirmation reservation detail is email generated; our system does not have the capability to alter any of the reservation details."There were also quite a few different fees hidden - This is what they would look like for 2 days:----------------------------------------Subtotal	£63.04Resort Fees	£5.16Tax Recovery Charges & Service Fees(See Details Below)£41.83Amount Paid	£110.03----------------------------------------In the end, I managed to cancel the reservation as it was free cancellation for the next 48 hours and booked it through Booking.comGiving them 4 stars because it's not a scam, and they replied to my email in a 12 hour timespan

title: If I could leave negative stars I would

They then add on additional taxes and fees that we don’t have in Australia, so if you are coming to Australia DO NOT book through this site. Either book through the property itself (which I thought I was doing) or a reputable site like Bookings.comIt is impossible to contact anyone to speak to  the phone number in Australia doesn’t connect it you request to speak to an agent and there is no email address to lodge a refund request.

name: jean-pierre riche
title: Be vigilant when using this website
text: Be careful when using this website...They show the price of the room and just as you put your credit card data they add on a massive service charge that was never mentioned beforeWe were booking a Best Western room thinking we were on their official site,they look similar that's the first part of the scam!We booked a 160 euros a night room, but the credit card bill is 245 euros, with a 85 euros service charge for the room!!!All other website including the hotel itself (the real site) are selling that same room at a real 160 euros with no extra charge!!!After putting a very negative review, they not only answered but refunded the full amount of the booking as a sign of good faith.Thank you for this significant commercial gesture, although it would be best to make the charges clear at the very beginning of the process, and apply service fees that are more in proportion with the value of the booking made.

name: Jenia Jenab-Wolcott
title: terrible reservation experience
text: Guest reservations=hotelvalues=priceline. I had made a reservation for 3 rooms (over $4000) 9 months in advance. I had no idea this was a non-refundable reservation. I called 4 month prior to our arrival to change the date of our travel by one day--I was told not possible. I tried to add a name of another guest to one of rooms--I was told not possible. My family and I travel very frequently and I NEVER purchase non-refundable rooms on purpose. The refund policy must have been well hidden that I did not realize at time of booking. I was surprised by how inflexible the company was and I do not intend to use them ever again.

text: There are many reviews to read on several sites. I got charged an unexpected fee that was more than half the cost of the hotel room I was booking. GR HAD paid for the room through booking.com, and kept the change. They are set up to make money and to make it as hard as possible to trace anything. They must have good lawyers, and their fine print probably protects them from any legal jeopardy.

name: Luísa Stella de Oliveira Coutinho Silva
title: This site charges your card with discretionary fees after you add your card number
text: This is a misleading website that shows you better prices for hotels and after you pay with your credit card they add taxes at their own criteria. They charge taxes WITHOUT informing you about it, charging a final price that you did not consent. BE CAREFUL!!! And they add the hotels name in the website address, so it really looks at first as the hotel website. And their phone number do not work. You always end listening to machines telling to contact the hotel.

name: Pablo
title: It's a legit website / company. Careful when typing your email though!
text: Be really careful when buying through the website.It IS LEGIT. However, making a typo in your email when booking would probably result on you having no reservation number / confirmation.I had paid for a 2-night stay in Railay Phutawan resort having thought it was their official website (just comparing prices with booking). Did not manage to see the email confirmation, but that happened because it went to my spam. However, when trying to figure out how to contact the company (you can email to legal [at] guestreservations [dot] com) it looks like there could be many problems if something goes wrong.Reading their email response, it seems you might not be able to retrieve your booking confirmation:"The booking confirmation reservation detail forwarded by email is the only payment receipt available for your reservation. [...] The booking confirmation reservation detail is email generated; our system does not have the capability to alter any of the reservation details."There were also quite a few different fees hidden - This is what they would look like for 2 days:----------------------------------------Subtotal	£63.04Resort Fees	£5.16Tax Recovery Charges & Service Fees(See Details Below)£41.83Amount Paid	£110.03----------------------------------------In the end, I managed to cancel the reservation as it was free cancellation for the next 48 hours and booked it through Booking.comGiving them 4 stars because it's not a scam, and they replied to my email in a 12 hour timespan

name: Franco Marchetti
title: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.com
text: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.comUPDATE – Company unresponsive after dispute openedAfter weeks of repeating the same generic answers and refusing to provide transaction details, I filed a formal dispute with my credit card issuer. Now Guest Reservations has stated they “can no longer help” because of the dispute. Avoid this company at all costs — they delay, deflect, and do not refund unless forced to.DO NOT BOOK THROUGH THIS SITE.Franco Marchetti

name: Sue
title: If I could leave negative stars I would
text: If I could leave negative stars I would.Do not use this website.  They make it look like you are booking directly through the property only to find out once you have paid that it’s a third party site.The price stated looks like it’s for the entire stay yet when you pay it’s per night. They then add on additional taxes and fees that we don’t have in Australia, so if you are coming to Australia DO NOT book through this site. Either book through the property itself (which I thought I was doing) or a reputable site like Bookings.comIt is impossible to contact anyone to speak to  the phone number in Australia doesn’t connect it you request to speak to an agent and there is no email address to lodge a refund request.

name: jean-pierre riche
title: Be vigilant when using this website
text: Be careful when using this website...They show the price of the room and just as you put your credit card data they add on a massive service charge that was never mentioned beforeWe were booking a Best Western room thinking we were on their official site,they look similar that's the first part of the scam!We booked a 160 euros a night room, but the credit card bill is 245 euros, with a 85 euros service charge for the room!!!All other website including the hotel itself (the real site) are selling that same room at a real 160 euros with no extra charge!!!After putting a very negative review, they not only answered but refunded the full amount of the booking as a sign of good faith.Thank you for this significant commercial gesture, although it would be best to make the charges clear at the very beginning of the process, and apply service fees that are more in proportion with the value of the booking made.

name: Jenia Jenab-Wolcott
title: terrible reservation experience
text: Guest reservations=hotelvalues=priceline. I had made a reservation for 3 rooms (over $4000) 9 months in advance. I had no idea this was a non-refundable reservation. I called 4 month prior to our arrival to change the date of our travel by one day--I was told not possible. I tried to add a name of another guest to one of rooms--I was told not possible. My family and I travel very frequently and I NEVER purchase non-refundable rooms on purpose. The refund policy must have been well hidden that I did not realize at time of booking. I was surprised by how inflexible the company was and I do not intend to use them ever again.

name: Philippe Uccle
title: Arnaque totale
text: Affichage de 240 € pour une chambre; Paiement dû : 343 €. Si vous ne faites pas attention, vous pensez réserver pour 240 € et on vous débite de 343 € (paiement additionnel de 143 € de taxes non détaillées et imaginaires). Méthode très critiquable. Résultat : j'ai réservé la même chambre pour 240 € sur Booking.com !Evitez ce site d'arnaqueurs.Displaying €240 for a room; Payment due: €343. If you're not careful, you think you're booking for €240 and are charged €343 (an additional payment of €143 in undetailed and imaginary taxes). This is a highly questionable method. As a result, I booked the same room for €240 on Booking.com!Avoid this scam site.

name: Elisha Cernuto
title: Spoofs Real Hotel Sites!!!!
text: *** Update*"**What a comical response below. They don't give you a reservation or confirmation number. They certainly don't have have you click an acknowledgement (unless they bury it in T&Cs), and redirect you from a legit website - without the hotels permission. I've been in law enforcement my entire adult life - this is a scam. A well ran scam, I'll admit. What a group of pathetic individuals that are top lazy to work themselves, so try to steal from others. This is a text book scam. I'll be taking further action to have this company investigated.They literally spoofed the ACTUAL hotels website I booked with (I almost always book direct) AND even charged it to the name of the hotel on my credit card. I booked a suite. I got here and had a "mini suite" booked in my name with a $300+ price difference. We realized on check in that was NOT our room and when they gave us the check-in paperwork, the price whoever booked this paid was over $300 cheaper than what I was charged. They added a fake phone number, email, and address to my reservation. The room was booked with a MasterCard that wasn't even mine. We refused to sign our name (since that's clearly a card that doesn't below to us). They don't send booking confirmations and if you call their customer service it says to "contact the hotel directly". FRAUD. Will be looking into reporting to law enforcement.

name: Gabriel
title: Reservation cancellation
text: Bad customer service, I booked a room on 04/14/25 and on the same day I asked to cancel because the person who was supposed to arrive could not. According to the company's policy, if I cancel before 04/27/25, I should receive a full refund. From then until today, I have been arguing with them about receiving a refund. They are not trying to help and claim that time has passed (because they have extended the time) and refuse to refund the payment that is in their policy. I would recommend being careful because they do not meet the conditions they themselves set.

name: Natalie
title: This is a scam - cancelled my stay and refused my refund
text: Update: Guest reservations replies to my post here and again tells me to email them. But I already have, to the same email they provide multiple times. No reply to my email!-------------------This is a scam. I called to ask for a refund. Twice before hanging up, I asked them NOT to cancel my booking as I needed the hotel reservation - unless the refund was confirmed.Shortly after hanging up, promising me they would follow up. Then I promptly received an email confirming my hotel reservation was cancelled. Then after my numerous email exchanges, still no refund.You cancel my hotel reservation then refuse to refund?I was forced to make a separate booking with the hotel.The last time they would email me back, they said their 3rd party booking partner had received full payment but refused the refund request. But the hotel confirmed with the said 3rd party directly, who confirmed by email that they never received any funds.Guest reservations stipulated that I must get an email from the hotel with name and title of the hotel employee, stating they will agree to the refund. But they cannot write me such an email because #1. their mysterious 3rd party agent never received the funds, and #2. the hotel itself never received the funds (which would be paid to them by the 3rd party agent).I had to pay AGAIN to make the same hotel booking directly on the hotel's website. The hotel kindly provided me with their correspondence with the said 3rd party agent. I sent all this plus my correspondence with the hotel to Guest Reservations as asked.But when I sent all this, all communications stopped. They're not even pretending to entertain the refund request now?Since it seems from the reviews that "some" people do get their refunds, can someone at Guest Reservations help me with a refund? Not sending me to another generic email with no response.

name: James Murphy
title: Guest Reservations - Buyer Beware - watch for the tax and service fees
text: Unfortunately I fell for this site thinking I was on crowne plaza in Birmingham nec.  Made a booking for a price under the room which was reasonable,  then on check out the price increased, I contacted Customer Service.Since writing this review, I've edited it, Guest Reservations has kindly refunded my payment on a non refundable room. I've increased from 1 star to 2 stars.It hasn't been an easy journey but an eye opener on what your paying for. Beware of added taxes and service charges, The real hotel couldn't understand why I was being charged more than what the real hotel was charging.Thank you for the refund,  but I will be very reluctant to use this site again. Too much stress over a booking. And while you say your charges are clearly visible , I did not see this until it was too late.If you what better reviews, please enter the actual cost per night under the room selected like most websites. Not have a lower price thinking your getting a good deal.

text: Be careful when using this website...They show the price of the room and just as you put your credit card data they add on a massive service charge that was never mentioned beforeWe were booking a Best Western room thinking we were on their official site,they look similar that's the first part of the scam!We booked a 160 euros a night room, but the credit card bill is 245 euros, with a 85 euros service charge for the room!!!All other website including the hotel itself (the real site) are selling that same room at a real 160 euros with no extra charge!!!After putting a very negative review, they not only answered but refunded the full amount of the booking as a sign of good faith.Thank you for this significant commercial gesture, although it would be best to make the charges clear at the very beginning of the process, and apply service fees that are more in proportion with the value of the booking made.

name: Jenia Jenab-Wolcott
title: terrible reservation experience
text: Guest reservations=hotelvalues=priceline. I had made a reservation for 3 rooms (over $4000) 9 months in advance. I had no idea this was a non-refundable reservation. I called 4 month prior to our arrival to change the date of our travel by one day--I was told not possible. I tried to add a name of another guest to one of rooms--I was told not possible. My family and I travel very frequently and I NEVER purchase non-refundable rooms on purpose. The refund policy must have been well hidden that I did not realize at time of booking. I was surprised by how inflexible the company was and I do not intend to use them ever again.

name: Philippe Uccle
title: Arnaque totale
text: Affichage de 240 € pour une chambre; Paiement dû : 343 €. Si vous ne faites pas attention, vous pensez réserver pour 240 € et on vous débite de 343 € (paiement additionnel de 143 € de taxes non détaillées et imaginaires). Méthode très critiquable. Résultat : j'ai réservé la même chambre pour 240 € sur Booking.com !Evitez ce site d'arnaqueurs.Displaying €240 for a room; Payment due: €343. If you're not careful, you think you're booking for €240 and are charged €343 (an additional payment of €143 in undetailed and imaginary taxes). This is a highly questionable method. As a result, I booked the same room for €240 on Booking.com!Avoid this scam site.

name: Elisha Cernuto
title: Spoofs Real Hotel Sites!!!!
text: *** Update*"**What a comical response below. They don't give you a reservation or confirmation number. They certainly don't have have you click an acknowledgement (unless they bury it in T&Cs), and redirect you from a legit website - without the hotels permission. I've been in law enforcement my entire adult life - this is a scam. A well ran scam, I'll admit. What a group of pathetic individuals that are top lazy to work themselves, so try to steal from others. This is a text book scam. I'll be taking further action to have this company investigated.They literally spoofed the ACTUAL hotels website I booked with (I almost always book direct) AND even charged it to the name of the hotel on my credit card. I booked a suite. I got here and had a "mini suite" booked in my name with a $300+ price difference. We realized on check in that was NOT our room and when they gave us the check-in paperwork, the price whoever booked this paid was over $300 cheaper than what I was charged. They added a fake phone number, email, and address to my reservation. The room was booked with a MasterCard that wasn't even mine. We refused to sign our name (since that's clearly a card that doesn't below to us). They don't send booking confirmations and if you call their customer service it says to "contact the hotel directly". FRAUD. Will be looking into reporting to law enforcement.

name: Gabriel
title: Reservation cancellation

They are not trying to help and claim that time has passed (because they have extended the time) and refuse to refund the payment that is in their policy. I would recommend being careful because they do not meet the conditions they themselves set.

title: This website is a complete scam

name: Natalie
title: This is a scam - cancelled my stay and refused my refund
text: Update: Guest reservations replies to my post here and again tells me to email them. But I already have, to the same email they provide multiple times. No reply to my email!-------------------This is a scam. I called to ask for a refund. Twice before hanging up, I asked them NOT to cancel my booking as I needed the hotel reservation - unless the refund was confirmed.Shortly after hanging up, promising me they would follow up. Then I promptly received an email confirming my hotel reservation was cancelled. Then after my numerous email exchanges, still no refund.You cancel my hotel reservation then refuse to refund?I was forced to make a separate booking with the hotel.The last time they would email me back, they said their 3rd party booking partner had received full payment but refused the refund request. But the hotel confirmed with the said 3rd party directly, who confirmed by email that they never received any funds.Guest reservations stipulated that I must get an email from the hotel with name and title of the hotel employee, stating they will agree to the refund. But they cannot write me such an email because #1. their mysterious 3rd party agent never received the funds, and #2. the hotel itself never received the funds (which would be paid to them by the 3rd party agent).I had to pay AGAIN to make the same hotel booking directly on the hotel's website. The hotel kindly provided me with their correspondence with the said 3rd party agent. I sent all this plus my correspondence with the hotel to Guest Reservations as asked.But when I sent all this, all communications stopped. They're not even pretending to entertain the refund request now?Since it seems from the reviews that "some" people do get their refunds, can someone at Guest Reservations help me with a refund? Not sending me to another generic email with no response.

title: The reservation went through even I…

name: James Murphy
title: Guest Reservations - Buyer Beware - watch for the tax and service fees
text: Unfortunately I fell for this site thinking I was on crowne plaza in Birmingham nec.  Made a booking for a price under the room which was reasonable,  then on check out the price increased, I contacted Customer Service.Since writing this review, I've edited it, Guest Reservations has kindly refunded my payment on a non refundable room. I've increased from 1 star to 2 stars.It hasn't been an easy journey but an eye opener on what your paying for. Beware of added taxes and service charges, The real hotel couldn't understand why I was being charged more than what the real hotel was charging.Thank you for the refund,  but I will be very reluctant to use this site again. Too much stress over a booking. And while you say your charges are clearly visible , I did not see this until it was too late.If you what better reviews, please enter the actual cost per night under the room selected like most websites. Not have a lower price thinking your getting a good deal.

name: Rebecca Grace
title: Do not use this site
text: Do not use this site.I thought I was booking direct with the hotel.When I received my confirmation email after paying for my accommodation, I got no copy of invoice or receipt. Something I need to attach my my client bills /expense claims.When I asked the hotel directly -they were wonderful (Rydges Wellington) - they were only able to forward me the receipt/invoice related to the payment they received from this website. Almost half of what I paid them. So I'm unable to claim my expenses correctly.When I tried to contact this website the automated voice and email system requires a confirmation number or itinerary number to proceed -something they conveniently never provide at time of booking and payment.It's now impossible for me to obtain a copy of my bill for the correct amount.

name: Caleb Crawford
title: Clicked on a price for Embassy Suites…
text: Clicked on a price for Embassy Suites indicating I was getting the room for $115. Before paying they offered $25 discount for creating account where I recieved a promo code. After applying the code and hitting pay now it charged my card $185.00. I called company and was left on hold after speaking to a manager who never spoke to me on the phone. I never was presented with an itemized break down of my transaction indicating the charge was going from $115 to $185 after a $25 discount was applied. This company showed no concern about the Rug Pull!!!

name: Nicholas
title: I was unhappy
text: There are many reviews to read on several sites. I got charged an unexpected fee that was more than half the cost of the hotel room I was booking. GR HAD paid for the room through booking.com, and kept the change. They are set up to make money and to make it as hard as possible to trace anything. They must have good lawyers, and their fine print probably protects them from any legal jeopardy.

name: Luísa Stella de Oliveira Coutinho Silva
title: This site charges your card with discretionary fees after you add your card number

And they add the hotels name in the website address, so it really looks at first as the hotel website. And their phone number do not work. You always end listening to machines telling to contact the hotel.

name: Pablo
title: It's a legit website / company. Careful when typing your email though!
text: Be really careful when buying through the website.It IS LEGIT. However, making a typo in your email when booking would probably result on you having no reservation number / confirmation.I had paid for a 2-night stay in Railay Phutawan resort having thought it was their official website (just comparing prices with booking). Did not manage to see the email confirmation, but that happened because it went to my spam. However, when trying to figure out how to contact the company (you can email to legal [at] guestreservations [dot] com) it looks like there could be many problems if something goes wrong.Reading their email response, it seems you might not be able to retrieve your booking confirmation:"The booking confirmation reservation detail forwarded by email is the only payment receipt available for your reservation. title: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.com

Avoid this company at all costs — they delay, deflect, and do not refund unless forced to.DO NOT BOOK THROUGH THIS SITE.Franco Marchetti

name: Natalie
title: This is a scam - cancelled my stay and refused my refund
text: Update: Guest reservations replies to my post here and again tells me to email them. But I already have, to the same email they provide multiple times. No reply to my email!-------------------This is a scam. I called to ask for a refund. Twice before hanging up, I asked them NOT to cancel my booking as I needed the hotel reservation - unless the refund was confirmed.Shortly after hanging up, promising me they would follow up. Then I promptly received an email confirming my hotel reservation was cancelled. Then after my numerous email exchanges, still no refund.You cancel my hotel reservation then refuse to refund?I was forced to make a separate booking with the hotel.The last time they would email me back, they said their 3rd party booking partner had received full payment but refused the refund request. But the hotel confirmed with the said 3rd party directly, who confirmed by email that they never received any funds.Guest reservations stipulated that I must get an email from the hotel with name and title of the hotel employee, stating they will agree to the refund. But they cannot write me such an email because #1. their mysterious 3rd party agent never received the funds, and #2. the hotel itself never received the funds (which would be paid to them by the 3rd party agent).I had to pay AGAIN to make the same hotel booking directly on the hotel's website. The hotel kindly provided me with their correspondence with the said 3rd party agent. I sent all this plus my correspondence with the hotel to Guest Reservations as asked.But when I sent all this, all communications stopped. They're not even pretending to entertain the refund request now?Since it seems from the reviews that "some" people do get their refunds, can someone at Guest Reservations help me with a refund? Not sending me to another generic email with no response.

name: James Murphy
title: Guest Reservations - Buyer Beware - watch for the tax and service fees
text: Unfortunately I fell for this site thinking I was on crowne plaza in Birmingham nec.  Made a booking for a price under the room which was reasonable,  then on check out the price increased, I contacted Customer Service.Since writing this review, I've edited it, Guest Reservations has kindly refunded my payment on a non refundable room. Not have a lower price thinking your getting a good deal.

title: Do not use this site

title: Clicked on a price for Embassy Suites…

title: I was unhappy

name: Luísa Stella de Oliveira Coutinho Silva

name: Pablo
title: It's a legit website / company. Careful when typing your email though!
text: Be really careful when buying through the website.It IS LEGIT. However, making a typo in your email when booking would probably result on you having no reservation number / confirmation.I had paid for a 2-night stay in Railay Phutawan resort having thought it was their official website (just comparing prices with booking). Did not manage to see the email confirmation, but that happened because it went to my spam. However, when trying to figure out how to contact the company (you can email to legal [at] guestreservations [dot] com) it looks like there could be many problems if something goes wrong.Reading their email response, it seems you might not be able to retrieve your booking confirmation:"The booking confirmation reservation detail forwarded by email is the only payment receipt available for your reservation. title: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.com

name: Sue
title: If I could leave negative stars I would

They make it look like you are booking directly through the property only to find out once you have paid that it’s a third party site.The price stated looks like it’s for the entire stay yet when you pay it’s per night. They then add on additional taxes and fees that we don’t have in Australia, so if you are coming to Australia DO NOT book through this site. Either book through the property itself (which I thought I was doing) or a reputable site like Bookings.comIt is impossible to contact anyone to speak to  the phone number in Australia doesn’t connect it you request to speak to an agent and there is no email address to lodge a refund request.

name: jean-pierre riche
title: Be vigilant when using this website
text: Be careful when using this website...They show the price of the room and just as you put your credit card data they add on a massive service charge that was never mentioned beforeWe were booking a Best Western room thinking we were on their official site,they look similar that's the first part of the scam!We booked a 160 euros a night room, but the credit card bill is 245 euros, with a 85 euros service charge for the room!!!All other website including the hotel itself (the real site) are selling that same room at a real 160 euros with no extra charge!!!After putting a very negative review, they not only answered but refunded the full amount of the booking as a sign of good faith.Thank you for this significant commercial gesture, although it would be best to make the charges clear at the very beginning of the process, and apply service fees that are more in proportion with the value of the booking made.

name: Jenia Jenab-Wolcott
title: terrible reservation experience
text: Guest reservations=hotelvalues=priceline. I had made a reservation for 3 rooms (over $4000) 9 months in advance. I had no idea this was a non-refundable reservation. I called 4 month prior to our arrival to change the date of our travel by one day--I was told not possible. I tried to add a name of another guest to one of rooms--I was told not possible. My family and I travel very frequently and I NEVER purchase non-refundable rooms on purpose. The refund policy must have been well hidden that I did not realize at time of booking. I was surprised by how inflexible the company was and I do not intend to use them ever again.

title: Arnaque totale
text: Affichage de 240 € pour une chambre; Paiement dû : 343 €. title: Spoofs Real Hotel Sites!!!!

We realized on check in that was NOT our room and when they gave us the check-in paperwork, the price whoever booked this paid was over $300 cheaper than what I was charged. They added a fake phone number, email, and address to my reservation. The room was booked with a MasterCard that wasn't even mine. We refused to sign our name (since that's clearly a card that doesn't below to us). They don't send booking confirmations and if you call their customer service it says to "contact the hotel directly". FRAUD. Will be looking into reporting to law enforcement.

text: Guest reservations=hotelvalues=priceline. I had made a reservation for 3 rooms (over $4000) 9 months in advance. I had no idea this was a non-refundable reservation. I called 4 month prior to our arrival to change the date of our travel by one day--I was told not possible. I tried to add a name of another guest to one of rooms--I was told not possible. My family and I travel very frequently and I NEVER purchase non-refundable rooms on purpose. The refund policy must have been well hidden that I did not realize at time of booking. I was surprised by how inflexible the company was and I do not intend to use them ever again.

name: Philippe Uccle
title: Arnaque totale
text: Affichage de 240 € pour une chambre; Paiement dû : 343 €. Si vous ne faites pas attention, vous pensez réserver pour 240 € et on vous débite de 343 € (paiement additionnel de 143 € de taxes non détaillées et imaginaires). Méthode très critiquable. Résultat : j'ai réservé la même chambre pour 240 € sur Booking.com !Evitez ce site d'arnaqueurs.Displaying €240 for a room; Payment due: €343. If you're not careful, you think you're booking for €240 and are charged €343 (an additional payment of €143 in undetailed and imaginary taxes). This is a highly questionable method. As a result, I booked the same room for €240 on Booking.com!Avoid this scam site.

name: Elisha Cernuto
title: Spoofs Real Hotel Sites!!!!
text: *** Update*"**What a comical response below. They don't give you a reservation or confirmation number. They certainly don't have have you click an acknowledgement (unless they bury it in T&Cs), and redirect you from a legit website - without the hotels permission. I've been in law enforcement my entire adult life - this is a scam. A well ran scam, I'll admit. What a group of pathetic individuals that are top lazy to work themselves, so try to steal from others. This is a text book scam. I'll be taking further action to have this company investigated.They literally spoofed the ACTUAL hotels website I booked with (I almost always book direct) AND even charged it to the name of the hotel on my credit card. I booked a suite. I got here and had a "mini suite" booked in my name with a $300+ price difference. We realized on check in that was NOT our room and when they gave us the check-in paperwork, the price whoever booked this paid was over $300 cheaper than what I was charged. They added a fake phone number, email, and address to my reservation. The room was booked with a MasterCard that wasn't even mine. We refused to sign our name (since that's clearly a card that doesn't below to us). They don't send booking confirmations and if you call their customer service it says to "contact the hotel directly". FRAUD. Will be looking into reporting to law enforcement.

name: Joanne Collins
title: I have been totally scammed by this…
text: I have been totally scammed by this company paid for my accommodation,need to go into hospital so wanted to cancel my pre paid accommodation...have been totally ignore by themI live in Australia and will be reporting them to consumer protection...I follow d their rules and they totally ignored me

name: Gabriel
title: Reservation cancellation
text: Bad customer service, I booked a room on 04/14/25 and on the same day I asked to cancel because the person who was supposed to arrive could not. According to the company's policy, if I cancel before 04/27/25, I should receive a full refund. From then until today, I have been arguing with them about receiving a refund. They are not trying to help and claim that time has passed (because they have extended the time) and refuse to refund the payment that is in their policy. I would recommend being careful because they do not meet the conditions they themselves set.

name: özde Alfar
title: I didn’t confirm the payment
text: I didn’t confirm the payment! I saw that the web site is charcing a lot more when I click the pay button. Then the web site asked for my 3D secure code and I didn’t enter the code, in fact I clicked the ‘cancel payment’ button but it charged me anyways, I was just informes that the booking was completed. BUT I DIDN’T COMPLETE, I WANTED TO CANCEL BEFORE I PAY, I DIDN’T ENTER MY CODE AND IT CHARGED ME ANYWAY.

name: AKHIL VERGHESE
title: Straight up fraudulent
text: Straight up fraudulent!1) Advertised as if it's the hotel original site2) Displayed a different price on the checkout page3) Doesn't send any confirmation email!4) Doesn't allow cancellation even after reaching out the second the checkout went through (there's no one to reach out to)DO NOT EVER USE THEM!

name: Fiammetta Sacconi
title: This website is a complete scam
text: This website is a complete scamI thought I was booking through the real property and only after the reservation was made I found out I in fact was not. I tried to cancel the payment, but that did not go through and they charged me a crazy fee. I now managed to cancel the booking and really hoping I will have my money back, even though by reading the reviews here I am starting getting more and more hopeless.God bless the EU's customer protection.

name: Natalie
title: This is a scam - cancelled my stay and refused my refund
text: Update: Guest reservations replies to my post here and again tells me to email them. But I already have, to the same email they provide multiple times. No reply to my email!-------------------This is a scam. I called to ask for a refund. Twice before hanging up, I asked them NOT to cancel my booking as I needed the hotel reservation - unless the refund was confirmed.Shortly after hanging up, promising me they would follow up. Then I promptly received an email confirming my hotel reservation was cancelled. Then after my numerous email exchanges, still no refund.You cancel my hotel reservation then refuse to refund?I was forced to make a separate booking with the hotel.The last time they would email me back, they said their 3rd party booking partner had received full payment but refused the refund request. But the hotel confirmed with the said 3rd party directly, who confirmed by email that they never received any funds.Guest reservations stipulated that I must get an email from the hotel with name and title of the hotel employee, stating they will agree to the refund. But they cannot write me such an email because #1. their mysterious 3rd party agent never received the funds, and #2. the hotel itself never received the funds (which would be paid to them by the 3rd party agent).I had to pay AGAIN to make the same hotel booking directly on the hotel's website. The hotel kindly provided me with their correspondence with the said 3rd party agent. I sent all this plus my correspondence with the hotel to Guest Reservations as asked.But when I sent all this, all communications stopped. They're not even pretending to entertain the refund request now?Since it seems from the reviews that "some" people do get their refunds, can someone at Guest Reservations help me with a refund? Not sending me to another generic email with no response.

name: Frustrated
title: The reservation went through even I…
text: The reservation went through even I didn’t confirm/complete the reservation. When I saw the additional fees I stopped the making the reservation and they charged my credit card without promission. And of course can’t contact the customer service. And no confirmation in email.

name: James Murphy
title: Guest Reservations - Buyer Beware - watch for the tax and service fees
text: Unfortunately I fell for this site thinking I was on crowne plaza in Birmingham nec.  Made a booking for a price under the room which was reasonable,  then on check out the price increased, I contacted Customer Service.Since writing this review, I've edited it, Guest Reservations has kindly refunded my payment on a non refundable room. I've increased from 1 star to 2 stars.It hasn't been an easy journey but an eye opener on what your paying for. Beware of added taxes and service charges, The real hotel couldn't understand why I was being charged more than what the real hotel was charging.Thank you for the refund,  but I will be very reluctant to use this site again. Too much stress over a booking. And while you say your charges are clearly visible , I did not see this until it was too late.If you what better reviews, please enter the actual cost per night under the room selected like most websites. Not have a lower price thinking your getting a good deal.

name: Rebecca Grace
title: Do not use this site
text: Do not use this site.I thought I was booking direct with the hotel.When I received my confirmation email after paying for my accommodation, I got no copy of invoice or receipt. Something I need to attach my my client bills /expense claims.When I asked the hotel directly -they were wonderful (Rydges Wellington) - they were only able to forward me the receipt/invoice related to the payment they received from this website. Almost half of what I paid them. So I'm unable to claim my expenses correctly.When I tried to contact this website the automated voice and email system requires a confirmation number or itinerary number to proceed -something they conveniently never provide at time of booking and payment.It's now impossible for me to obtain a copy of my bill for the correct amount.

name: Mark
title: Website charging extremely high service…
text: Website charging extremely high service charges. Dont use them

name: Caleb Crawford
title: Clicked on a price for Embassy Suites…
text: Clicked on a price for Embassy Suites indicating I was getting the room for $115. Before paying they offered $25 discount for creating account where I recieved a promo code. After applying the code and hitting pay now it charged my card $185.00. I called company and was left on hold after speaking to a manager who never spoke to me on the phone. When Representative came back on the phone, she offered me an $11 discount. I never was presented with an itemized break down of my transaction indicating the charge was going from $115 to $185 after a $25 discount was applied. This company showed no concern about the Rug Pull!!!

name: Nicholas
title: I was unhappy
text: There are many reviews to read on several sites. I got charged an unexpected fee that was more than half the cost of the hotel room I was booking. GR HAD paid for the room through booking.com, and kept the change. They are set up to make money and to make it as hard as possible to trace anything. They must have good lawyers, and their fine print probably protects them from any legal jeopardy.

name: Luísa Stella de Oliveira Coutinho Silva
title: This site charges your card with discretionary fees after you add your card number
text: This is a misleading website that shows you better prices for hotels and after you pay with your credit card they add taxes at their own criteria. They charge taxes WITHOUT informing you about it, charging a final price that you did not consent. BE CAREFUL!!! And they add the hotels name in the website address, so it really looks at first as the hotel website. And their phone number do not work. You always end listening to machines telling to contact the hotel.

name: Pablo
title: It's a legit website / company. Careful when typing your email though!
text: Be really careful when buying through the website.It IS LEGIT. However, making a typo in your email when booking would probably result on you having no reservation number / confirmation.I had paid for a 2-night stay in Railay Phutawan resort having thought it was their official website (just comparing prices with booking). Did not manage to see the email confirmation, but that happened because it went to my spam. However, when trying to figure out how to contact the company (you can email to legal [at] guestreservations [dot] com) it looks like there could be many problems if something goes wrong.Reading their email response, it seems you might not be able to retrieve your booking confirmation:"The booking confirmation reservation detail forwarded by email is the only payment receipt available for your reservation. [...] The booking confirmation reservation detail is email generated; our system does not have the capability to alter any of the reservation details."There were also quite a few different fees hidden - This is what they would look like for 2 days:----------------------------------------Subtotal	£63.04Resort Fees	£5.16Tax Recovery Charges & Service Fees(See Details Below)£41.83Amount Paid	£110.03----------------------------------------In the end, I managed to cancel the reservation as it was free cancellation for the next 48 hours and booked it through Booking.comGiving them 4 stars because it's not a scam, and they replied to my email in a 12 hour timespan

name: Franco Marchetti
title: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.com
text: ❌ Review for GuestReservations.comUPDATE – Company unresponsive after dispute openedAfter weeks of repeating the same generic answers and refusing to provide transaction details, I filed a formal dispute with my credit card issuer. Now Guest Reservations has stated they “can no longer help” because of the dispute. Avoid this company at all costs — they delay, deflect, and do not refund unless forced to.DO NOT BOOK THROUGH THIS SITE.Franco Marchetti

name: Sue
title: If I could leave negative stars I would
text: If I could leave negative stars I would.Do not use this website.  They make it look like you are booking directly through the property only to find out once you have paid that it’s a third party site.The price stated looks like it’s for the entire stay yet when you pay it’s per night. They then add on additional taxes and fees that we don’t have in Australia, so if you are coming to Australia DO NOT book through this site. Either book through the property itself (which I thought I was doing) or a reputable site like Bookings.comIt is impossible to contact anyone to speak to  the phone number in Australia doesn’t connect it you request to speak to an agent and there is no email address to lodge a refund request.

name: jean-pierre riche
title: Be vigilant when using this website
text: Be careful when using this website...They show the price of the room and just as you put your credit card data they add on a massive service charge that was never mentioned beforeWe were booking a Best Western room thinking we were on their official site,they look similar that's the first part of the scam!We booked a 160 euros a night room, but the credit card bill is 245 euros, with a 85 euros service charge for the room!!!All other website including the hotel itself (the real site) are selling that same room at a real 160 euros with no extra charge!!!After putting a very negative review, they not only answered but refunded the full amount of the booking as a sign of good faith.Thank you for this significant commercial gesture, although it would be best to make the charges clear at the very beginning of the process, and apply service fees that are more in proportion with the value of the booking made.

text: Don't book with them! They will most likely have an issue sending you your reservation email. I Got off the phone with her and showed my confirmation email to the customer service rep at the lot, he then told me I could go ahead with the booking but there would be a charge of $41 on top of the $24 I just paid in CAD He told me it would be cheaper to just go with their rate so I did. Which costs me $49.Okay, whatever, I needed to catch my flight because I was operating it! Fast forward from January 11 to now today, January 14. I called to explain my situation and get a refund, but there is no understanding from this company whatsoever. They did not refund me my money and told me that it says they put in the confirmation email that I would be charged extra, but that's not the point. The point is I did not get to read the email l it was sent to me the same day when I was already at the lot, of course, I did not go through it when I was in crunch time trying to catch the shuttle. There was no empathy from them. Anyway, I saw all this to say be careful before you book!! They already have an option on their customer service phone line for confirmation email troubles!!!

title: Don't book with them
text: Don't book with them! They will most likely have an issue sending you your reservation email. The point is I did not get to read the email l it was sent to me the same day when I was already at the lot, of course, I did not go through it when I was in crunch time trying to catch the shuttle. name: Jerry Zaabel
title: Irresponsible Company
text: I have a campground in Northern AZ. at my horse ranch.  A person rented an RV from Outdoorsy and had it delivered to my property for their visit while participating in a horse clinic.  The renter was flying in from out of state.  The RV owner called me several times while driving to my ranch asking for directions.  She was having a hard time with directions and by the tone of her voice was getting more and more angry.  When they finally arrived at the ranch she pushed the entrance button to open the gate. When the gate opened half way.  Her husband who was driving the pick up truck pulling the RV attempted to drive through the partly open gate and struck the gate causing damage to both his vehicle and the gate opener.  The woman (RV Owner) was extremely upset and jumped out of the truck and pushed the gate causing the already damaged opener to total destruction.  The cost to repair was twenty five hundred dollars.  Outdoorsey's insurance refused to pay for the damage saying that type of damage didn't fit their policy.  They went on to say their policy covers Malicious Mischief or vandalism and/or direct collision.  Both of which were the case here.  After several weeks of "investigation"the insurance sent me a denial letter.  I would not do business with this company.  They are irresponsible and I wonder what they would have done if someone was injured.

name: Rylan Anderson
title: Worst experience I’ve ever had in my life
text: Renting a vehicle from outdoorsy was hands down the worst experience ive ever had dealing with a company, ANY COMPANY. Not only was the cost astronomical, they downsized us from a van to an SUV 2 weeks before our trip was supposed tk start, meaning we couldn't fit everyone we had originally planned. The truck broke down on our 2nd day, no refunds were ever provided for the money we had to spend to fix someone else’s vehicle. They booked us for the wrong dates and then used that as an excuse to keep our damage deposit. The owner used foul and harsh language towards me, calling me all kinds of names and awful things because I asked to get reimbursed for the money we had to spend to fix his vehicle that he rented us, not to mention losing out on multiple days of our trip and not being able to do what we wanted to do on the trip in the first place. And then after all that the owner is trying to charge me 1500$ in damages that were already there on the truck when we got it. This entire website is a scam for con artists trying to bleed money out of people and get repairs done on their vehicles for free. No matter what, DO NOT USE THIS SITE! You will regret it. Everyone I know who’s used this site has had the same experience or worse. Rent from literally anyone else and it will be better and cheaper than this.  I tried to apply for a partial refund, got denied. I had to literally go change my banking information to stop them from taking money of out my account without my permission. Sketchiest most awful company ever. Id rather poop in my hands and clap then give these guys another dollar.

name: Neil Charlton
title: A great partnership!
text: Outdoorsy has allowed me to rent my multiple trailers to customers in a seamless fashion, while helping me to maintain communication and customer service throughout the process!

name: Cat Smith
title: Westfalia campervans
text: I've enjoyed using this platform to find renters for my campervans. The experience has been very positive, I've had the pleasure of hosting renters from Europe, United States and Canada.The payments arrive on time. I feel confident that my Vans are fully insured.I do wish the platform was a bit more user friendly. I find it difficult at times to quickly use the platform to find information, such as my reviews and downloads for forms I need like the contract. Don't often know which Outdoorsy site I'm suppose to be using.Overall a very good experience so far.

name: Curtis  Scott
title: Outdoorsy makes it simple to rent out…
text: Outdoorsy makes it simple to rent out our travel trailer. Take some pic's, Complete and post the listing and the messages start coming.

name: Bréhier Chloé
title: My trip was a full success
text: Thanks to Harry my trip was a success !He took away my stress and got me everthing I needed : good tips, good camping Gear, good tire, good communication. First solo trip was lush! Made me want to do it again !

name: Cam Bogan
title: For Outdoorsy C-Suite
text: First of all, full transparency, I have never booked through Outdoorsy. What I have done is researched the internet universe to find an affordable place to live for a bit less than a year, because I am temporarily homeless. I specifically included the term "long-term" in the Google Search along with "RV rentals" and Outdoorsy came up close to the top and stated there on the Results page, "So unless you're looking for a 6 month rental..." , so I decided to see what was available on your site. I used your filter to choose my price range (by the way, you really need to add a Sort option to list RV's from least to most/most to least expensive option, because without it, you're wasting your customer's most important and non-renewable resource, their time) and realized that there was no option for long-term rentals with a reasonable monthly charge option. And thanks to the lack of Sort option for price-grouping, I had to look through 50+ options that were in my area. Since listings are ALL by the night and most for over $100 a night, that would make my legitimately long-term need of a 7 month rental (specifically 11/1-05/31), at $100 a night, $22K. The people that have the kind of money that make this amount seem reasonable, would likely just buy an RV, that way they can use it then put it on here for their entertainment subscription fund. I'm not asking you to stop being a predatory American company, I'm just asking you to be more honest and direct with your offerings. And, if you're already missing me before I sign off, don't despair, I will be doing another one of these reviews  for your unbelievably manipulative process by which you require customers to run around in figurative circles to close their Outdoorsy account. Toodles!

name: Chris Kutensky
title: I have been a long time host and renter, with Outdoorsy and others
text: I have been a long time renter and host, for 8yrs with Outdoorsy, as I recall. I'm my experience, they have a fantastic website and process. At days end, they are middle men. I felt that they handled CV19 when business was ten fold, smoothly when they were likely under staffed and many inexperienced renters, we're on the road renting RVs because airplanes were shutdown. I host in CO, a tourist state and if I had 20 Airstreams, I could have rented them all, easily. I can only imagine how hard Outdoorsy and other RV vendors worked to try to keep millions of units and millions of personalities Happy! It's a law of averages, and you'll always have some negatives, but as you can see it's 5% and when I was a kid, 95% was an A+.  Having rented and hosted for years I've learned any negative review is just like anything, it's based on personality and expectations, unless there is a blatant neglect of communication. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. I recommend you consider the RVs age first, as age has wear/tear, and match that age to the competitive cost. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. With a great of Tv experience, I know some folks get upset about small things where others accept that "life happens". Wear and tear exists when you rent units over 5yrs, it's part of Rv life, there are tons of forums you should look into, per model you wish to rent, as that can help too.  Life is short, enjoy your vacation and just know that the older the "rental unit" it's more likely to have some small glitch occur, and don't try to fix or work on a Hosts Rv, without working with them, as I've seen people break things trying to Google How To, so let your Host handle it. And if an RV repairman need to get involved, hand it off to Host, they need to know who's working on their unit, and they know their Rv best, or either way, let them pay direct, hand it off to them, so you can go back to enjoying your time with family, friends or your journey.Two way communication is the answer. And thanks to the lack of Sort option for price-grouping, I had to look through 50+ options that were in my area. Since listings are ALL by the night and most for over $100 a night, that would make my legitimately long-term need of a 7 month rental (specifically 11/1-05/31), at $100 a night, $22K. The people that have the kind of money that make this amount seem reasonable, would likely just buy an RV, that way they can use it then put it on here for their entertainment subscription fund. I'm not asking you to stop being a predatory American company, I'm just asking you to be more honest and direct with your offerings. And, if you're already missing me before I sign off, don't despair, I will be doing another one of these reviews  for your unbelievably manipulative process by which you require customers to run around in figurative circles to close their Outdoorsy account. Toodles!

name: Chris Kutensky
title: I have been a long time host and renter, with Outdoorsy and others
text: I have been a long time renter and host, for 8yrs with Outdoorsy, as I recall. I'm my experience, they have a fantastic website and process. At days end, they are middle men. I felt that they handled CV19 when business was ten fold, smoothly when they were likely under staffed and many inexperienced renters, we're on the road renting RVs because airplanes were shutdown. I host in CO, a tourist state and if I had 20 Airstreams, I could have rented them all, easily. I can only imagine how hard Outdoorsy and other RV vendors worked to try to keep millions of units and millions of personalities Happy! It's a law of averages, and you'll always have some negatives, but as you can see it's 5% and when I was a kid, 95% was an A+.  Having rented and hosted for years I've learned any negative review is just like anything, it's based on personality and expectations, unless there is a blatant neglect of communication. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. I recommend you consider the RVs age first, as age has wear/tear, and match that age to the competitive cost. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. I saw this as I've had 1 or 2 personalities who tend, finding to complain whether RV, other industries / business they get involved in, they just tend to demand and it's just characteristic, no matter who the vendor may be. In today's world, it's hard to connect with this persona as they communicate one-way, and talk at you, instead of with you. I've seen very very few, but it's exaggeration and characteristic of the submitter, but to submit 1 star, even start to a middleman vendor, seems more emotional, than offering readers the positives. Why blame Outdoorsy unless the entire vacation was unruly managed start to finish, canceled or destroyed, at their direct blame. I just think emotions are not good reviews. With a great of Tv experience, I know some folks get upset about small things where others accept that "life happens". Wear and tear exists when you rent units over 5yrs, it's part of Rv life, there are tons of forums you should look into, per model you wish to rent, as that can help too.  Life is short, enjoy your vacation and just know that the older the "rental unit" it's more likely to have some small glitch occur, and don't try to fix or work on a Hosts Rv, without working with them, as I've seen people break things trying to Google How To, so let your Host handle it. And if an RV repairman need to get involved, hand it off to Host, they need to know who's working on their unit, and they know their Rv best, or either way, let them pay direct, hand it off to them, so you can go back to enjoying your time with family, friends or your journey.Two way communication is the answer. As long as there is two-way communication, there is no issue that can't be resolved. And no need to blame Outdoorsy or other vendors in general, your our Guest(s). Just work together and you will be in the 95%, I say, from my years in Rv works. Hope this helps!
