It's a law of averages, and you'll always have some negatives, but as you can see it's 5% and when I was a kid, 95% was an A+.  Having rented and hosted for years I've learned any negative review is just like anything, it's based on personality and expectations, unless there is a blatant neglect of communication. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. I recommend you consider the RVs age first, as age has wear/tear, and match that age to the competitive cost. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. I saw this as I've had 1 or 2 personalities who tend, finding to complain whether RV, other industries / business they get involved in, they just tend to demand and it's just characteristic, no matter who the vendor may be. With a great of Tv experience, I know some folks get upset about small things where others accept that "life happens". Wear and tear exists when you rent units over 5yrs, it's part of Rv life, there are tons of forums you should look into, per model you wish to rent, as that can help too.  Life is short, enjoy your vacation and just know that the older the "rental unit" it's more likely to have some small glitch occur, and don't try to fix or work on a Hosts Rv, without working with them, as I've seen people break things trying to Google How To, so let your Host handle it. And if an RV repairman need to get involved, hand it off to Host, they need to know who's working on their unit, and they know their Rv best, or either way, let them pay direct, hand it off to them, so you can go back to enjoying your time with family, friends or your journey.Two way communication is the answer. As long as there is two-way communication, there is no issue that can't be resolved. And no need to blame Outdoorsy or other vendors in general, your our Guest(s). Just work together and you will be in the 95%, I say, from my years in Rv works. Hope this helps!

title: For Outdoorsy C-Suite
text: First of all, full transparency, I have never booked through Outdoorsy. I used your filter to choose my price range (by the way, you really need to add a Sort option to list RV's from least to most/most to least expensive option, because without it, you're wasting your customer's most important and non-renewable resource, their time) and realized that there was no option for long-term rentals with a reasonable monthly charge option. And thanks to the lack of Sort option for price-grouping, I had to look through 50+ options that were in my area. Since listings are ALL by the night and most for over $100 a night, that would make my legitimately long-term need of a 7 month rental (specifically 11/1-05/31), at $100 a night, $22K. The people that have the kind of money that make this amount seem reasonable, would likely just buy an RV, that way they can use it then put it on here for their entertainment subscription fund. I'm not asking you to stop being a predatory American company, I'm just asking you to be more honest and direct with your offerings. And, if you're already missing me before I sign off, don't despair, I will be doing another one of these reviews  for your unbelievably manipulative process by which you require customers to run around in figurative circles to close their Outdoorsy account. Toodles!

name: Chris Kutensky
title: I have been a long time host and renter, with Outdoorsy and others
text: I have been a long time renter and host, for 8yrs with Outdoorsy, as I recall. I'm my experience, they have a fantastic website and process. At days end, they are middle men. I felt that they handled CV19 when business was ten fold, smoothly when they were likely under staffed and many inexperienced renters, we're on the road renting RVs because airplanes were shutdown. I host in CO, a tourist state and if I had 20 Airstreams, I could have rented them all, easily. I can only imagine how hard Outdoorsy and other RV vendors worked to try to keep millions of units and millions of personalities Happy! It's a law of averages, and you'll always have some negatives, but as you can see it's 5% and when I was a kid, 95% was an A+.  Having rented and hosted for years I've learned any negative review is just like anything, it's based on personality and expectations, unless there is a blatant neglect of communication. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. I recommend you consider the RVs age first, as age has wear/tear, and match that age to the competitive cost. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. I saw this as I've had 1 or 2 personalities who tend, finding to complain whether RV, other industries / business they get involved in, they just tend to demand and it's just characteristic, no matter who the vendor may be. In today's world, it's hard to connect with this persona as they communicate one-way, and talk at you, instead of with you. I've seen very very few, but it's exaggeration and characteristic of the submitter, but to submit 1 star, even start to a middleman vendor, seems more emotional, than offering readers the positives. Why blame Outdoorsy unless the entire vacation was unruly managed start to finish, canceled or destroyed, at their direct blame. I just think emotions are not good reviews. With a great of Tv experience, I know some folks get upset about small things where others accept that "life happens". Wear and tear exists when you rent units over 5yrs, it's part of Rv life, there are tons of forums you should look into, per model you wish to rent, as that can help too.  Life is short, enjoy your vacation and just know that the older the "rental unit" it's more likely to have some small glitch occur, and don't try to fix or work on a Hosts Rv, without working with them, as I've seen people break things trying to Google How To, so let your Host handle it. And if an RV repairman need to get involved, hand it off to Host, they need to know who's working on their unit, and they know their Rv best, or either way, let them pay direct, hand it off to them, so you can go back to enjoying your time with family, friends or your journey.Two way communication is the answer. As long as there is two-way communication, there is no issue that can't be resolved. And no need to blame Outdoorsy or other vendors in general, your our Guest(s). Just work together and you will be in the 95%, I say, from my years in Rv works. Hope this helps!

I used your filter to choose my price range (by the way, you really need to add a Sort option to list RV's from least to most/most to least expensive option, because without it, you're wasting your customer's most important and non-renewable resource, their time) and realized that there was no option for long-term rentals with a reasonable monthly charge option. And thanks to the lack of Sort option for price-grouping, I had to look through 50+ options that were in my area. Since listings are ALL by the night and most for over $100 a night, that would make my legitimately long-term need of a 7 month rental (specifically 11/1-05/31), at $100 a night, $22K. The people that have the kind of money that make this amount seem reasonable, would likely just buy an RV, that way they can use it then put it on here for their entertainment subscription fund. I'm not asking you to stop being a predatory American company, I'm just asking you to be more honest and direct with your offerings. And, if you're already missing me before I sign off, don't despair, I will be doing another one of these reviews  for your unbelievably manipulative process by which you require customers to run around in figurative circles to close their Outdoorsy account. Toodles!

name: Chris Kutensky
title: I have been a long time host and renter, with Outdoorsy and others
text: I have been a long time renter and host, for 8yrs with Outdoorsy, as I recall. I'm my experience, they have a fantastic website and process. At days end, they are middle men. I felt that they handled CV19 when business was ten fold, smoothly when they were likely under staffed and many inexperienced renters, we're on the road renting RVs because airplanes were shutdown. I host in CO, a tourist state and if I had 20 Airstreams, I could have rented them all, easily. I can only imagine how hard Outdoorsy and other RV vendors worked to try to keep millions of units and millions of personalities Happy! It's a law of averages, and you'll always have some negatives, but as you can see it's 5% and when I was a kid, 95% was an A+.  Having rented and hosted for years I've learned any negative review is just like anything, it's based on personality and expectations, unless there is a blatant neglect of communication. Otherwise, personality plays a role, and I'm just as guilty of having too high expectations and no different than a dating website, every profile has a certain effort to market, whether price point, or allowing Pets when other do not.So, I say, always look at the big picture and the % of positive stars as some people post negatively based on emotion, or one-sided points of views, for example, host or renter. I recommend you consider the RVs age first, as age has wear/tear, and match that age to the competitive cost. Photos are great on sewing the design and general unit, but it doesn't show parts and like an aged car, truck, computer, what have you, age plays a role. Personally, I am thankful for Outdoors, introducing me to some fantastic, renters and I truly enjoy RVs and love being a Host, seeing renters come home after their journey and family vacation, all relaxed and happy. You can see the stress that has left their shoulders from PickUp to DropOff. BUT that said, there will always be certain personalities that you just can't live up to their expectations, and as a Host, you just tell them, text me, call me, let me know how I can help. We will handle any issues that comes up, if any, work with RV repair vendors, pay them, and upon drop off, if determined it wasn't Wear/Tear, we have deposits to reimburse us, but we just want you to enjoy, and so does Outdoors. It's a vacation, time to relax and enjoy and avoid making Mountains out of MoleHills as they say, as it's all comes out in the wash.  And over many years, I have issues as both renter and host, always minor but even issues with Brand New trucks or Rvs, it can happen, so keep comms open, that's what I recommend. No one wants a bad vacation for anyone, and that certainly not why Outdoorsy and Hosts option this industry. I saw this as I've had 1 or 2 personalities who tend, finding to complain whether RV, other industries / business they get involved in, they just tend to demand and it's just characteristic, no matter who the vendor may be. In today's world, it's hard to connect with this persona as they communicate one-way, and talk at you, instead of with you. I've seen very very few, but it's exaggeration and characteristic of the submitter, but to submit 1 star, even start to a middleman vendor, seems more emotional, than offering readers the positives. Why blame Outdoorsy unless the entire vacation was unruly managed start to finish, canceled or destroyed, at their direct blame. I just think emotions are not good reviews. With a great of Tv experience, I know some folks get upset about small things where others accept that "life happens". Wear and tear exists when you rent units over 5yrs, it's part of Rv life, there are tons of forums you should look into, per model you wish to rent, as that can help too.  Life is short, enjoy your vacation and just know that the older the "rental unit" it's more likely to have some small glitch occur, and don't try to fix or work on a Hosts Rv, without working with them, as I've seen people break things trying to Google How To, so let your Host handle it. And if an RV repairman need to get involved, hand it off to Host, they need to know who's working on their unit, and they know their Rv best, or either way, let them pay direct, hand it off to them, so you can go back to enjoying your time with family, friends or your journey.Two way communication is the answer. As long as there is two-way communication, there is no issue that can't be resolved. And no need to blame Outdoorsy or other vendors in general, your our Guest(s). Just work together and you will be in the 95%, I say, from my years in Rv works. Hope this helps!

name: Modoka
title: I was a Host on Outdoorsy
text: I was a Host on Outdoorsy.The hosting process just to get started was aggravating to begin with.  It's like no-one was serious about helping me get started.  You had to send them the same documents multiple times and they just kept passing you to the next customer service representative. The customer service was crap... After 2 or 3 weeks of trying to get set up, I was finally able to.  Skip to my first and only renter..  After their trip, they returned the camper late, and I understand things happen.  However, the Toilet/Tank was full and clogged first off.  I had to pay for the state park to let me empty it.  Next I noticed on the outside of the travel trailer there was duct tape across the arms and the main beam of the awning, Stretching the entire length.   Last, one of my slide outs were stuck in and and wouldn't go back out.  Mind you I emailed outdoorsy the photos plus receipts and I had to hire a mobile RV Mechanic to make the slide out work again.  They did a review and said they can't use the customers deposit for the damages.  (EXCUSE ME!) I understood that's what a deposit is for.  So that if something breaks that the deposit will help pay for the damages.. HUH, I guess not.  Either way Ive emailed back and forth with the piece of crap company and gotten nowhere.  They refuse to take the money out of the customers deposit and not pay me back for the mobile mechanic or the waste fee.  To me it's just the point of it all.  I do not recommend anyone using outdoorsy for your RV rental hosting needs.  BEWARE!!!

Outdoorsy created a claim against me and is holding my deposit even through both the owner and I sent emails saying we don’t want a claim. name: JEFFROW
title: An absolute disaster and a vacation…
text: An absolute disaster and a vacation planned a year in advance ruined! The RV we rented broke down 900 miles from home, outdoorsy told us they would come pick up the vehicle and left my wife, our 7 month old baby and myself stranded. They said we should figure it out! There was no replacement rental and we had to rent a vehicle that would not fit all our camp gear (coolers, stove, and more)so we were forced to abandon it also lost $400 worth of  groceries that was in the refrigerator.Being stranded over night and more than 16 hours of trying to resolve the matter we were just defeated 😞 after we got home we called outdoorsy and they offered us $100 for our next trip with them. The most inconsiderate disrespectful customer service you could imagine. Imagine being stranded 900 miles from home in an RV you spent $3000 to rent and when it breaks down they come pick it up and leave you, your family and your gear in some random neighborhood on the side walk and they assure you that you can figure it out!!!Please don’t let this happen to you.

name: Julia Soh
title: Rental went well until return with minor damage.
text: Rental went well until we returned the vehicle with a minor damage. Repair costs were outrageous! Outdoorsy tested my credit card for reauthorizing my card on the deposit without letting me know with a suspicious identity. I cancelled my card and had to deal with all that hassle before finding out Outdoorsy wanted me to pay the insurance deductible. Sending a check instead of giving my new credit card number was complicated because they insisted on a USD check.

name: C. Flint
title: HORRIBLE company
text: HORRIBLE company. NEVER do business with them, unless you want to be stuck holding the bill for an accident. They denied a simple claim with a mechanic statement indicating it was a "freak accident" because Outdoorsy claimed it was a mechanical issue. It wasn't, clearly stated by the mechanic. They would rather you run the RV off the road and cause thousands of dollars in damage. Avoid their "Peace of Mind" Insurance package at all costs - they are just going to deny everything anyway. You're better off returning a damaged RV and making them take you to court than bothering trying to make a legitimate claim.

name: kerriecameron
title: At a loss for our holidays because customer service did nothing to help us
text: After booking an RV we tried contacting the host to set up arrangements.  The host wasn't responding. I emailed host once 3 weeks and a second time one week before reaching out to customer support for help.Customer supports response was that they give hosts 24-48 hours to respond because "we understand life can throw your routine off".  I replied with our timeline of trying to contact the host and asked that they help us reach the host. I haven't heard anything back from customer support after this.I emailed multiple times and I called multiple times. No one would answer the call, and once I was on hold for 30 minutes (no exaggeration) to only be disconnected after a recording told me no one was available to take my call.I reached out on social media with my situation and got a response to call or email customer support for assistance... really?!  That response just added more to my frustration.I had to cancel my reservation one week before our holidays because of the unresponsive host and lack of support from the folks at outdoorsy.  Thankfully the amount was deposited back into my account.Now aside from this frustrating experience with outdoorsy and their host, I am $80 out of pocket for the "service fee" that wasn't refunded... Really?!  What service did I pay for??  A whole lot of wasted time on my end for trying to get service, I should charge outdoorsy for my time, not the other way around.But the worst part of all this is my family and I have been looking forward to this, our annual holiday that we work very hard to afford and now we don't know what we're going to do.  We have a campground  booked with nothing to bring with us. So to quote your customer service I guess "life can throw your routine off" but replace "life" with "outdoorsy".From this experience, my take away is outdoorsy doesn't care. At no point did anyone on your end try to resolve this matter.  You have profited off my service fee and my family is now at a loss on what we will do.  An appropriate action on your part would have been to 1) Respond to our concerns first and foremost 2) Try to resolve our concerns by helping us contact the host 3) If the host remained unresponsive, find another solution if possible.  Would there have been another rental you could have helped us manage? We even would have paid more for a bigger camper if necessary.  But unfortunately none of that happened.No one wins from this experience! Outdoorsy, sure you made money from my service fee, but you had to refund $800 and our holidays are one week away and we don't know what we're going to do.Outdoorsy if you do care about the people you are providing services to and making a profit off of, you still have time to make this right for me and my family. I have little hope, but at this time I have little options.

name: Justin Pintler
title: Funds take too long to be deposited
text: It takes a little long for the funds to be added to my account. Especially if the funds are released on a Thursday, I typically won’t see them in my account until Monday.  Which, considering all the technology out there with banking doesn’t make a lot of sense.I also don’t think there should be fees on any add-ons or damage damages that are taken out of the security deposit.  I know it’s a small amount, but every penny counts considering the amount that is taken out of the rental.Overall, I would say I’m happy with using the service, but I am looking at other options as well.

name: Brett Johnson
title: Do not use Outdoorsy

name: LG
title: This was a great deal including flight…
text: This was a great deal including flight and hotel. Kaanapali Beach Resort is a nice resort right on the beach. They have a pool and restauraunts onsite. The breakfast buffet at HeleOn was delicious. We were not fans of the food at Maui Brew Co and our waitress was not the best either. However, every staff from the front desk to the tour desk, and the staff running the activities are wonderful. We took 3 different classes, lei making, ukulele and hula and enjoyed each of the classes. They make it fun and informative and teach you about the true culture of Hawaii before tourism. Everyone was very friendly and treated you like family. They also had a scavenger hunt book for the kids which my 6 year old liked walking around the resort learning about Hawaiian plants, birds, people hand made items and other things. He also completed the pages required and as a bonus got a cute Hawaiian stuffed animal bird and a pin to place on his kukui nut lei. We also enjoyed the traditional kukui nut lei ceremony they had before departure.

name: customer
title: Seamless experience
text: Great value vacations made for a seamless experience in Ireland. We printed our vouchers ahead of time, which saved a lot of time. We handed them to the attendant and were on our excursions immediately. accommodations were incredible.

name: Martin Edward Skibba
title: Do not go if Angel Grana is the Tour Director
text: I have gone on multiple guided tours to include Scottland, Ireland, England, Paris, and Greece. This was the first with Cosmos through Great Values.Not until 2 months before our trip did I learn that Great Value uses a third party (Cosmos) for guided vacations. After reading 25 pages of restrictions and rules, and  phone calls to clarify luggage restrictions and incorrect flight times we went on our trip.In spit of our Tour Guide, Angel Grana (focused on 1 dictator, 1 MOB boss (who played poker while ladies were under the table giving BJs, music because he was in a band, low wages so he needed more tips, every Country besides Spain sucked, the past Pope (didn't) and new Pope (won't) do anything.Multiple times we stayed late in hotels only to have 50 mintues at a stop (to check out the area or get lunch but not both).We found the Countries and People to be very beautiful and engaging.

name: Soledad Martinez
title: Everything came as expected
text: Everything came as expected. GVV  one more made a memorable experience. The only reason I did not give five stars is because they changed without notice from a real insurance to just "protection plan" I realized until I paid more than seven hundreds for basically nothing. I had to spend another five hundred for a real insurance.

name: Debra Tucker
title: Dominican Vacation
text: United airlines flights were terrible. We were not seated together. The hotel is mediocre. Bland food and poor service. There were a lot of bugs, and poor services at the hotel.

name: Deidre King-Sovereen
title: The Resort we stayed at was not a "Great Value Vacation"
text: The Resort we stayed at, someone flushed a bar of soap down the toilet in our room.  Soon as we got there, we used it and it overflowed all over the floor and it took them hours to clean it up. They accused us of doing it.  The shower would leak out into the bathroom and around the toilet and we had towels everywhere, trying to dry up the mess. They weren't willing to keep us in towels because even though you put a sign on the door meant nothing.  We asked for another room and they said they couldn't. The roof leaking at the entrance of our building and we got wet every time we walked in or out. There were Cats everywhere even in the cafeteria, one guest said one ran in their room and jumped on the bed.  They said they have restaurants, but they have one, the alcohol was extra for top shelf and only one beer, draft it was Presidente   We called another resort, and they had no room, willing to pay the difference, because it was our Ten-year Wedding Anniversary.  We ended up staying and no one spoke English.  I paid 70 dollars for a foot massage. Reflexology and thought why is she not working on my foot, maybe she would eventually get there.  But then she was done, she didn't read or understand my receipt.  I left with my foot still throbbing.  I went to the food truck and asked for a simple hotdog and got fried chicken bites.  It was a complete disaster, but no one was willing to help us get out.  The Resort is falling apart, nothing is maintained.  We were stuck there for 6 days.  So, our Anniversary was not what we had hoped, very disappointed!!!

name: Andrew
title: everything worked out well!
text: We love how your company had the car rental setup and had selected lovely hotels.  We were confident of this based on previous experience with GVV.

name: Lynn
title: Portugal deserves more than 5 stars!
text: We had a great time in Portugal - Lisbon and then a train ride to Porto. Three days in each city was enough time to enjoy the many things that each city had to offer. We used the fourth day to take a day trip from both Lisbon and Porto - Sintra and Guimaraes respectively. The hotels were very, very nice with bountiful breakfasts, giving us fuel to start the day. The hotels were conveniently located near Metro lines which took us to the city centers. Everything worked seamlessly from the airline check in to the hotels, and then the train. We had a wonderful time and as always Great Value Vacations was a wise chose for our holiday.

title: Great experience
text: Great experience!Alot of walking and some tours didn't explain all the free time you would get to be able to schedule your own excursions.

name: Megan Marie Witt
title: I really valued the vacation…

name: LG
title: This was a great deal including flight…
text: This was a great deal including flight and hotel. Kaanapali Beach Resort is a nice resort right on the beach. They have a pool and restauraunts onsite. The breakfast buffet at HeleOn was delicious. We were not fans of the food at Maui Brew Co and our waitress was not the best either. However, every staff from the front desk to the tour desk, and the staff running the activities are wonderful. We took 3 different classes, lei making, ukulele and hula and enjoyed each of the classes. They make it fun and informative and teach you about the true culture of Hawaii before tourism. Everyone was very friendly and treated you like family. They also had a scavenger hunt book for the kids which my 6 year old liked walking around the resort learning about Hawaiian plants, birds, people hand made items and other things. He also completed the pages required and as a bonus got a cute Hawaiian stuffed animal bird and a pin to place on his kukui nut lei. We also enjoyed the traditional kukui nut lei ceremony they had before departure.

name: customer
title: Seamless experience
text: Great value vacations made for a seamless experience in Ireland. We printed our vouchers ahead of time, which saved a lot of time. We handed them to the attendant and were on our excursions immediately. accommodations were incredible.

name: Martin Edward Skibba
title: Do not go if Angel Grana is the Tour Director
text: I have gone on multiple guided tours to include Scottland, Ireland, England, Paris, and Greece. This was the first with Cosmos through Great Values.Not until 2 months before our trip did I learn that Great Value uses a third party (Cosmos) for guided vacations. After reading 25 pages of restrictions and rules, and  phone calls to clarify luggage restrictions and incorrect flight times we went on our trip.In spit of our Tour Guide, Angel Grana (focused on 1 dictator, 1 MOB boss (who played poker while ladies were under the table giving BJs, music because he was in a band, low wages so he needed more tips, every Country besides Spain sucked, the past Pope (didn't) and new Pope (won't) do anything.Multiple times we stayed late in hotels only to have 50 mintues at a stop (to check out the area or get lunch but not both).We found the Countries and People to be very beautiful and engaging.

name: Soledad Martinez
title: Everything came as expected
text: Everything came as expected. GVV  one more made a memorable experience. I had to spend another five hundred for a real insurance.

name: Debra Tucker
title: Dominican Vacation

name: Deidre King-Sovereen
title: The Resort we stayed at was not a "Great Value Vacation"
text: The Resort we stayed at, someone flushed a bar of soap down the toilet in our room.  Soon as we got there, we used it and it overflowed all over the floor and it took them hours to clean it up. They accused us of doing it.  The shower would leak out into the bathroom and around the toilet and we had towels everywhere, trying to dry up the mess. They weren't willing to keep us in towels because even though you put a sign on the door meant nothing.  We asked for another room and they said they couldn't. The roof leaking at the entrance of our building and we got wet every time we walked in or out. There were Cats everywhere even in the cafeteria, one guest said one ran in their room and jumped on the bed.  They said they have restaurants, but they have one, the alcohol was extra for top shelf and only one beer, draft it was Presidente   We called another resort, and they had no room, willing to pay the difference, because it was our Ten-year Wedding Anniversary.  We ended up staying and no one spoke English.  I paid 70 dollars for a foot massage. Reflexology and thought why is she not working on my foot, maybe she would eventually get there.  But then she was done, she didn't read or understand my receipt.  I left with my foot still throbbing.  I went to the food truck and asked for a simple hotdog and got fried chicken bites.  It was a complete disaster, but no one was willing to help us get out.  The Resort is falling apart, nothing is maintained.  We were stuck there for 6 days.  So, our Anniversary was not what we had hoped, very disappointed!!!

text: United airlines flights were terrible. We were not seated together. The hotel is mediocre. Bland food and poor service. There were a lot of bugs, and poor services at the hotel.

name: Deidre King-Sovereen
title: The Resort we stayed at was not a "Great Value Vacation"
text: The Resort we stayed at, someone flushed a bar of soap down the toilet in our room.  Soon as we got there, we used it and it overflowed all over the floor and it took them hours to clean it up. They accused us of doing it.  The shower would leak out into the bathroom and around the toilet and we had towels everywhere, trying to dry up the mess. They weren't willing to keep us in towels because even though you put a sign on the door meant nothing.  We asked for another room and they said they couldn't. The roof leaking at the entrance of our building and we got wet every time we walked in or out. There were Cats everywhere even in the cafeteria, one guest said one ran in their room and jumped on the bed.  They said they have restaurants, but they have one, the alcohol was extra for top shelf and only one beer, draft it was Presidente   We called another resort, and they had no room, willing to pay the difference, because it was our Ten-year Wedding Anniversary.  We ended up staying and no one spoke English.  I paid 70 dollars for a foot massage. Reflexology and thought why is she not working on my foot, maybe she would eventually get there.  But then she was done, she didn't read or understand my receipt.  I left with my foot still throbbing.  I went to the food truck and asked for a simple hotdog and got fried chicken bites.  It was a complete disaster, but no one was willing to help us get out.  The Resort is falling apart, nothing is maintained.  We were stuck there for 6 days.  So, our Anniversary was not what we had hoped, very disappointed!!!

name: Andrew
title: everything worked out well!
text: We love how your company had the car rental setup and had selected lovely hotels.  We were confident of this based on previous experience with GVV.

name: Lynn
title: Portugal deserves more than 5 stars!
text: We had a great time in Portugal - Lisbon and then a train ride to Porto. Three days in each city was enough time to enjoy the many things that each city had to offer. We used the fourth day to take a day trip from both Lisbon and Porto - Sintra and Guimaraes respectively. The hotels were very, very nice with bountiful breakfasts, giving us fuel to start the day. The hotels were conveniently located near Metro lines which took us to the city centers. Everything worked seamlessly from the airline check in to the hotels, and then the train. We had a wonderful time and as always Great Value Vacations was a wise chose for our holiday.

name: Megan Marie Witt
title: I really valued the vacation…
text: I really valued the vacation destination. The downside was the effort and cost to attractions.

name: LG
title: This was a great deal including flight…
text: This was a great deal including flight and hotel. Kaanapali Beach Resort is a nice resort right on the beach. They have a pool and restauraunts onsite. The breakfast buffet at HeleOn was delicious. We were not fans of the food at Maui Brew Co and our waitress was not the best either. However, every staff from the front desk to the tour desk, and the staff running the activities are wonderful. We took 3 different classes, lei making, ukulele and hula and enjoyed each of the classes. They make it fun and informative and teach you about the true culture of Hawaii before tourism. Everyone was very friendly and treated you like family. They also had a scavenger hunt book for the kids which my 6 year old liked walking around the resort learning about Hawaiian plants, birds, people hand made items and other things. He also completed the pages required and as a bonus got a cute Hawaiian stuffed animal bird and a pin to place on his kukui nut lei. We also enjoyed the traditional kukui nut lei ceremony they had before departure.

name: customer
title: Seamless experience
text: Great value vacations made for a seamless experience in Ireland. We printed our vouchers ahead of time, which saved a lot of time. We handed them to the attendant and were on our excursions immediately. accommodations were incredible.

title: Do not go if Angel Grana is the Tour Director

text: I absolutely loved my experience with this company! Went to Ireland for 7 days and it was one of the smoothest vacations I’ve ever been to! From the arrival to the airport, to the pickUp of the car rental, hotel check ins, activities and just overall everything that was included! I did not have to worry about or stress about it. The hotels were 4 stars hotels and in good areas! I am very happy and will definitely be traveling again with this company!

name: Megan Marie Witt
title: I really valued the vacation…
text: I really valued the vacation destination. The downside was the effort and cost to attractions.

name: LG
title: This was a great deal including flight…
text: This was a great deal including flight and hotel. Kaanapali Beach Resort is a nice resort right on the beach. They have a pool and restauraunts onsite. The breakfast buffet at HeleOn was delicious. We were not fans of the food at Maui Brew Co and our waitress was not the best either. However, every staff from the front desk to the tour desk, and the staff running the activities are wonderful. We took 3 different classes, lei making, ukulele and hula and enjoyed each of the classes. They make it fun and informative and teach you about the true culture of Hawaii before tourism. Everyone was very friendly and treated you like family. They also had a scavenger hunt book for the kids which my 6 year old liked walking around the resort learning about Hawaiian plants, birds, people hand made items and other things. He also completed the pages required and as a bonus got a cute Hawaiian stuffed animal bird and a pin to place on his kukui nut lei. We also enjoyed the traditional kukui nut lei ceremony they had before departure.

name: customer
title: Seamless experience
text: Great value vacations made for a seamless experience in Ireland. We printed our vouchers ahead of time, which saved a lot of time. We handed them to the attendant and were on our excursions immediately. accommodations were incredible.

name: Martin Edward Skibba
title: Do not go if Angel Grana is the Tour Director
text: I have gone on multiple guided tours to include Scottland, Ireland, England, Paris, and Greece. This was the first with Cosmos through Great Values.Not until 2 months before our trip did I learn that Great Value uses a third party (Cosmos) for guided vacations. After reading 25 pages of restrictions and rules, and  phone calls to clarify luggage restrictions and incorrect flight times we went on our trip.In spit of our Tour Guide, Angel Grana (focused on 1 dictator, 1 MOB boss (who played poker while ladies were under the table giving BJs, music because he was in a band, low wages so he needed more tips, every Country besides Spain sucked, the past Pope (didn't) and new Pope (won't) do anything.Multiple times we stayed late in hotels only to have 50 mintues at a stop (to check out the area or get lunch but not both).We found the Countries and People to be very beautiful and engaging.

name: Soledad Martinez
title: Everything came as expected
text: Everything came as expected. GVV  one more made a memorable experience. The only reason I did not give five stars is because they changed without notice from a real insurance to just "protection plan" I realized until I paid more than seven hundreds for basically nothing. I had to spend another five hundred for a real insurance.

name: Debra Tucker
title: Dominican Vacation
text: United airlines flights were terrible. We were not seated together. The hotel is mediocre. Bland food and poor service. There were a lot of bugs, and poor services at the hotel.

name: Deidre King-Sovereen
title: The Resort we stayed at was not a "Great Value Vacation"
text: The Resort we stayed at, someone flushed a bar of soap down the toilet in our room.  Soon as we got there, we used it and it overflowed all over the floor and it took them hours to clean it up. They accused us of doing it.  The shower would leak out into the bathroom and around the toilet and we had towels everywhere, trying to dry up the mess. They weren't willing to keep us in towels because even though you put a sign on the door meant nothing.  We asked for another room and they said they couldn't. The roof leaking at the entrance of our building and we got wet every time we walked in or out. There were Cats everywhere even in the cafeteria, one guest said one ran in their room and jumped on the bed.  They said they have restaurants, but they have one, the alcohol was extra for top shelf and only one beer, draft it was Presidente   We called another resort, and they had no room, willing to pay the difference, because it was our Ten-year Wedding Anniversary.  We ended up staying and no one spoke English.  I paid 70 dollars for a foot massage. Reflexology and thought why is she not working on my foot, maybe she would eventually get there.  But then she was done, she didn't read or understand my receipt.  I left with my foot still throbbing.  I went to the food truck and asked for a simple hotdog and got fried chicken bites.  It was a complete disaster, but no one was willing to help us get out.  The Resort is falling apart, nothing is maintained.  We were stuck there for 6 days.  So, our Anniversary was not what we had hoped, very disappointed!!!

name: Andrew
title: everything worked out well!
text: We love how your company had the car rental setup and had selected lovely hotels.  We were confident of this based on previous experience with GVV.

name: Lynn
title: Portugal deserves more than 5 stars!
text: We had a great time in Portugal - Lisbon and then a train ride to Porto. Three days in each city was enough time to enjoy the many things that each city had to offer. We used the fourth day to take a day trip from both Lisbon and Porto - Sintra and Guimaraes respectively. The hotels were very, very nice with bountiful breakfasts, giving us fuel to start the day. The hotels were conveniently located near Metro lines which took us to the city centers. Everything worked seamlessly from the airline check in to the hotels, and then the train. We had a wonderful time and as always Great Value Vacations was a wise chose for our holiday.

name: Walter Nasi
title: Great experience
text: Great experience!Alot of walking and some tours didn't explain all the free time you would get to be able to schedule your own excursions.

name: REBECCA
title: Another fantastic vacation through…
text: Another fantastic vacation through Great Value Vacations! Everything went very smoothly. I love having the flight, hotel, and rail taken care of with the freedom to create my own itinerary once there!

name: Larry Victor Cortinas
title: Loved our trip to Maui
text: Loved our trip to Maui!  Resort we stayed in was wonderful.  Airfare was also included in our trip.   Great value for the money we paid.  Will definitely look for good deals through them again.

name: Amaury M
title: Great experience
text: Great experience, everything was well organized and easy to follow.

name: Linds
title: Never booking with GVV again
text: I hate to even say this but this vacation was a nightmare from start to finish. This was our honeymoon and I wish we had never booked this trip. GVV dropped the mall many times with our reservations and flights. I can guarantee I will never book with GVV again.

name: Cheryl Gunnerson
title: I would have given a 5 star rating
text: I would have given a 5 star rating, I was not thrilled with the flight arrangement due to the long layovers. The trip was absolutely amazing!  We were able to see just about everything we wanted and more!  This is my second trip with Great Value Vacations and will not be my last!

name: Michael Boyd Bloomfield
title: Hotel was ok in London and Rome
text: Hotel was ok in London and Rome, but Paris hotel room was tiny.? This was our third trip using GVV, but hotels were not up to previous hotels, standards. London hotel didn’t supply breakfasts like the other two. All three were convenient to metro lines and easily accessed. Hotel staffs were very helpful.Previous trips through GVV to Ireland, Scotland and Greece were outstanding.

name: Suzanne
title: Art tour in Europe
text: My daughter and I went on a tour of Italy, France and Belgium. The experience was amazing. The hotels they booked for our group were clean comfortable and offered continental breakfast. Our tour buses were kept nice and the bus drivers super friendly. The daily activities were great but not always planned in the most optimal way.  We wasted a lot of time on the bus or rushing place to place. We wished we were given more time at the museums and more free time to explore on our own. Our tour guide was great and definitely kept us on track which is difficult with teenagers. The group dinners were a nice time to get to know each other and the restaurant's chosen treated us wonderfully. We flew Air Canada and I was impressed by the service we received. Overall it was an amazing once in a lifetime trip!

name: Richard Baskin
title: Impressed with EF
text: My EF rep is great--positive, professional, and ready to help with whatever is needed.  I have been impressed by the online resources available to me, such as the promotional calendar, ready to use emails, and up-to-date information on program enrollees.  Based on my research into EF, I started this process with a great deal of confidence in them, and nothing has changed that.

name: Sadie Andros
title: Our Incredible Odyssey Full of History, Culture, & Feta
text: Our trip to Greece was amazing from start to finish! We saw so much: from the gorgeous sea views at the Temple of Poseidon to the peaceful mountains and ancient ruins in Delphi--not to mention a dip in the healing waters of Lake Vouliagmeni which was only a short car ride from our hotel in Glyfada. The food of Greece is fantastic (bring on the feta and the gyros) and don't get us started on all of our feline friends we made along the way! The trip was definitely fully packed and a bit exhausting at times, but every moment was worth it. What really made our tour incredible was our amazing tour guide, Kyriakos. He brought so much heart, humor, and knowledge to the experience and our students absolutely LOVED him. We came home exhausted but full of memories that will last us a lifetime and with a great appreciation for this beautiful country. Efharisto, Kyri & EF for this incredible experience for our students!

name: Sarah Roerick
title: Our tour guide and our bus drivers
text: Our tour guide and our bus drivers, they made the trip so educational and little side bits of knowledge. They were all outstanding. Our 3-night stay wasn't exactly the cleanest hotel, but we made it work having a Starbucks next door helped every morning with a mood change! Otherwise, it was a great trip and I would highly recommend to others!

title: Our Incredible Odyssey Full of History, Culture, & Feta
text: Our trip to Greece was amazing from start to finish! We saw so much: from the gorgeous sea views at the Temple of Poseidon to the peaceful mountains and ancient ruins in Delphi--not to mention a dip in the healing waters of Lake Vouliagmeni which was only a short car ride from our hotel in Glyfada. The food of Greece is fantastic (bring on the feta and the gyros) and don't get us started on all of our feline friends we made along the way! The trip was definitely fully packed and a bit exhausting at times, but every moment was worth it. What really made our tour incredible was our amazing tour guide, Kyriakos. He brought so much heart, humor, and knowledge to the experience and our students absolutely LOVED him. We came home exhausted but full of memories that will last us a lifetime and with a great appreciation for this beautiful country. Efharisto, Kyri & EF for this incredible experience for our students!

text: We have been members of THS for 2 years and have taken 5 or 6 holidays. Each time the Sitters we got were 5 * and looked after our dogs and our house very well. The site is easy use and offers a perfect solution for pet and house minding when going on holidays travelling for work.

name: Kayleigh Darling
title: I used THS for 22 days after reaching…
text: I used Trusted House Sitters for 22 days after reaching out to a couple who referred me to the website as they were not able to sit for me. I believe this is the first ploy in marketing this website and that actually they were never really going to be available and just market this app.Upon submitting a listing I quickly received an application from a young girl, with AI looking photos, who got my name completely wrong and offered to sit my dogs, she had no reviews, lives in Maylasia apparently. THS claims people are verified but it seemed suspect to me and like a fake profile. This did not feel like a sensible or safe application to accept and I proceeded to invite a number of people to sit for me, all of which declined, or just didn’t reply at all.After 22 days and worrying about availability for summer holidays I decided THS wasn’t for me or worth the £139 (and that’s a basic membership with a discount apparently).I asked to have a partial refund given my short lived and negative experience, I was told this would be escalated to a manager and was informed within a few hours there would be no refund, none of the details I shared were taken into consideration and I was told this decision is final.I do not recommend, go for something else like Rover where you pay for sitters but there are a lot more reviews and at least you get replies more quickly from members because they’re being paid. I found 3 offers to accept for dog sitting within 3 hours.Rubbish customer service, rubbish experience.

name: Sue
title: We've had 3 brilliant house sits so far…
text: We've had 3 brilliant house sits so far with Trusted Housesitters and couldn't be happier. The website is easy to navigate and set up searches, plus there is a good selection of high quality potential sits.

name: Amy Jeroloman
title: The Site Favors Sitters over Housesits & the messaging is misleading
text: I spend a lot of time making a profile and loading pictures for a housesit. There were two applicants which then makes me not eligible for a refund. One waiting nearly 2 weeks to say she couldn’t come since she didn’t have a car. The other took another sit just before we were to meet.Many of the sitters have profiles that aren’t actuate. Some don’t live in the state listed, others don’t want local sits or long sits. Some aren’t really available since their calendar’s aren’t up to date. Some are unreliable and don’t follow through since there isn’t any loyalty to the Pet Parent.I’ve also recently realized some sitters are using this site to promote their personal pet sitting business at an expensive rates. (Some are on Facebook.) They’ll use the reviews and background checks from this site to show they are ‘trusted’Lessons Learned: Basic plans are not eligible for a refund. If you get two applicants, you’re not eligible. The site favors sitters over housesits. Don’t believe the auto messages to sit back and wait for applications. Better look and make offers if you want to have a sitter through this site. I’ve had to hire a local person, not on this site, at twice the regular rates and also additional charges for each pet. Ouch.

name: Marion Milne
title: What a great company is Trusted…

name: Caroline Cloutier
title: Used it over 50 times.
text: I both hosted over 20 sits and completed over 20 pet sits. I cannot say enough good things about THS. I have so many good experiences thanks to it. The platform is straightforward to navigate, and the app is efficient and clear. Excellent customer service in case of needing assistance. I recommend it to everyone who loves pets and loves to travel. It is safe and efficient, and makes travelling easier for everyone!

name: Jill Harty
title: Don't hesitate, dive right in
text: We thoroughly recommend THS. We have been full-time petsitting for near three years and are currently on our 102nd sit! Throughout we have had very positive experiences petsitting, met some lovely humans & pets. We have developed new skill, visited interesting places and probably walked a long way! We have found THS works really well both for the sitter & the homeowner. So whether considering using the site as a homeowner or as a sitter, or both, dive right in, it's definitely worth it. 🙂

title: Win Win

name: Aliesha Pulliam
title: A blessing for pet parents in mourning
text: After laying my pup-son to rest, I was missing the comfort of taking care of a dog. We were together for 14 years, but the idea of getting another dog of my own was just too much. Enter TrustedHousesitters. My very first sit was with a senior pup from the same breed group as my little man and I was smitten! I love that THS gives me the flexibility to spend time with pets at my leisure while also making new connections all around my city. I've recently started taking sits outside of my state and I'm excited to work my way up to international sits. This platform has been a godsend for me and I know it's been a blessing to the homeowners knowing their homes and pets are safe and well taken care of.

I believe this is the first ploy in marketing this website and that actually they were never really going to be available and just market this app.Upon submitting a listing I quickly received an application from a young girl, with AI looking photos, who got my name completely wrong and offered to sit my dogs, she had no reviews, lives in Maylasia apparently. THS claims people are verified but it seemed suspect to me and like a fake profile. This did not feel like a sensible or safe application to accept and I proceeded to invite a number of people to sit for me, all of which declined, or just didn’t reply at all.After 22 days and worrying about availability for summer holidays I decided THS wasn’t for me or worth the £139 (and that’s a basic membership with a discount apparently).I asked to have a partial refund given my short lived and negative experience, I was told this would be escalated to a manager and was informed within a few hours there would be no refund, none of the details I shared were taken into consideration and I was told this decision is final.I do not recommend, go for something else like Rover where you pay for sitters but there are a lot more reviews and at least you get replies more quickly from members because they’re being paid. I found 3 offers to accept for dog sitting within 3 hours.Rubbish customer service, rubbish experience.

name: Amy Jeroloman
title: The Site Favors Sitters over Housesits & the messaging is misleading
text: I spend a lot of time making a profile and loading pictures for a housesit. There were two applicants which then makes me not eligible for a refund. One waiting nearly 2 weeks to say she couldn’t come since she didn’t have a car. The other took another sit just before we were to meet.Many of the sitters have profiles that aren’t actuate. Some don’t live in the state listed, others don’t want local sits or long sits. Some aren’t really available since their calendar’s aren’t up to date. Some are unreliable and don’t follow through since there isn’t any loyalty to the Pet Parent.I’ve also recently realized some sitters are using this site to promote their personal pet sitting business at an expensive rates. (Some are on Facebook.) They’ll use the reviews and background checks from this site to show they are ‘trusted’Lessons Learned: Basic plans are not eligible for a refund. If you get two applicants, you’re not eligible. The site favors sitters over housesits. Don’t believe the auto messages to sit back and wait for applications. Better look and make offers if you want to have a sitter through this site. I’ve had to hire a local person, not on this site, at twice the regular rates and also additional charges for each pet. Ouch.

name: Kayleigh Darling
title: I used THS for 22 days after reaching…
text: I used Trusted House Sitters for 22 days after reaching out to a couple who referred me to the website as they were not able to sit for me. I believe this is the first ploy in marketing this website and that actually they were never really going to be available and just market this app.Upon submitting a listing I quickly received an application from a young girl, with AI looking photos, who got my name completely wrong and offered to sit my dogs, she had no reviews, lives in Maylasia apparently. THS claims people are verified but it seemed suspect to me and like a fake profile. This did not feel like a sensible or safe application to accept and I proceeded to invite a number of people to sit for me, all of which declined, or just didn’t reply at all.After 22 days and worrying about availability for summer holidays I decided THS wasn’t for me or worth the £139 (and that’s a basic membership with a discount apparently).I asked to have a partial refund given my short lived and negative experience, I was told this would be escalated to a manager and was informed within a few hours there would be no refund, none of the details I shared were taken into consideration and I was told this decision is final.I do not recommend, go for something else like Rover where you pay for sitters but there are a lot more reviews and at least you get replies more quickly from members because they’re being paid. I found 3 offers to accept for dog sitting within 3 hours.Rubbish customer service, rubbish experience.

name: Amy Jeroloman
title: The Site Favors Sitters over Housesits & the messaging is misleading
text: I spend a lot of time making a profile and loading pictures for a housesit. There were two applicants which then makes me not eligible for a refund. One waiting nearly 2 weeks to say she couldn’t come since she didn’t have a car. The other took another sit just before we were to meet.Many of the sitters have profiles that aren’t actuate. Some don’t live in the state listed, others don’t want local sits or long sits. Some aren’t really available since their calendar’s aren’t up to date. Some are unreliable and don’t follow through since there isn’t any loyalty to the Pet Parent.I’ve also recently realized some sitters are using this site to promote their personal pet sitting business at an expensive rates. (Some are on Facebook.) They’ll use the reviews and background checks from this site to show they are ‘trusted’Lessons Learned: Basic plans are not eligible for a refund. If you get two applicants, you’re not eligible. The site favors sitters over housesits. Don’t believe the auto messages to sit back and wait for applications. Better look and make offers if you want to have a sitter through this site. I’ve had to hire a local person, not on this site, at twice the regular rates and also additional charges for each pet. Ouch.

text: We lost $5,000 for our Cancun trip. Paid it all up front and now their website is completely down. We paid with a debit card, therefore cannot get any of our money back.

name: Renée Johnson Walsh
title: Took them to Small Claims Court (though it won't work)!
text: Like so many others, I booked a trip with Bookit.com and paid them over $4000. We were so excited to go to Aruba for our anniversary in October! In March, they canceled our trip, never having ever paid our resort a single cent for our booking. We paid with a debit card, so there is no protection for us or way to get our money back. We have taken them to small claims court, but the attorneys never get a response from the company, and they're definitely not going to send anyone to appear in court in Massachusetts when they are based in Florida. Theoretically, that means we "Win" the case, but we know that we're never going to see a cent of that money returned to us! I can't believe this fraud goes unpunished by the law!!

name: Jong An
title: Refund lies
text: Cancelled the trip one month before a trip and received e mail that I will be getting refund to credit card on 3/18/2020. It has been now three months and there is no refund to my credit card! I disputed with the Credit card company but credit card charge of $5800 still there!

name: James C
title: Cockroach of the industry
text: They canceled my $3200 vacation and refuse to refund my money. I contacted my credit card company. Bookit is fighting the charge back. I will get my money back. It's taking alot of phone calls and persistent nagging. ALWAYS book trips with a credit card because they offer protection. I never thought I would need to fight for my money back. If you paid for your trip with a credit card make sure you start a case now. I am into this for 2.5 months and still waiting on a resolution. Bookit is a scum company. How could they dispute my charge back. Look elsewhere for your vacation needs. Good luck everyone.

title: Extremely Misleading Premium Package  BCA-6897029
text: Extremely Misleading Premium Package – Avoid BudgetAirI had a very frustrating experience with BudgetAir after purchasing their so-called Premium Service Package. I paid extra expecting flexibility, such as the ability to change my flight without additional fees. However, when I needed to make a change, I was told the airline doesn’t allow modifications — making the entire premium package completely useless.What’s worse, BudgetAir continued to justify this by saying the package only waives their service fee, not the airline's. So essentially, if your airline doesn’t allow changes, the premium package provides zero value. No refund. No alternative. Nothing.When I asked why their system would even allow someone to purchase an upgrade that offers no actual benefits based on the ticket type, they gave vague, conflicting responses. They claimed the conditions were shown during booking, but at no point did I see a warning or any clear explanation that the premium package wouldn’t apply to my fare. title: Extremely Misleading Premium Package  BCA-6897029
text: Extremely Misleading Premium Package – Avoid BudgetAirI had a very frustrating experience with BudgetAir after purchasing their so-called Premium Service Package. Nothing.When I asked why their system would even allow someone to purchase an upgrade that offers no actual benefits based on the ticket type, they gave vague, conflicting responses. BudgetAir’s customer service was robotic, unhelpful, and completely dismissive of the issue.In short: Don’t waste your money on their Premium Package. It’s a bait-and-switch. name: Hardeep
title: Extremely Misleading Premium Package  BCA-6897029
text: Extremely Misleading Premium Package – Avoid BudgetAirI had a very frustrating experience with BudgetAir after purchasing their so-called Premium Service Package. I paid extra expecting flexibility, such as the ability to change my flight without additional fees. However, when I needed to make a change, I was told the airline doesn’t allow modifications — making the entire premium package completely useless.What’s worse, BudgetAir continued to justify this by saying the package only waives their service fee, not the airline's. So essentially, if your airline doesn’t allow changes, the premium package provides zero value. No refund. No alternative. Nothing.When I asked why their system would even allow someone to purchase an upgrade that offers no actual benefits based on the ticket type, they gave vague, conflicting responses. They claimed the conditions were shown during booking, but at no point did I see a warning or any clear explanation that the premium package wouldn’t apply to my fare. They also refused to provide any official documentation or a link outlining what this package actually includes.This is either poor system design or intentionally misleading, and they place the blame entirely on the customer. BudgetAir’s customer service was robotic, unhelpful, and completely dismissive of the issue.In short: Don’t waste your money on their Premium Package. It’s a bait-and-switch. And their support won’t do anything to help once they’ve taken your money.

name: David Oddi
title: This is a very fraudulent company
text: This is a very fraudulent company. If anyone is seeking to rent an RV, do not go thru the process of renting from RVshare. This company breaks its own rules to make money. I rented a camper in OK in Sept 2024 for 4 days. First of all when I went to pick up this camper, the owner never showed up to do the out paperwork to go over any damage before I rented it. I returned the camper on the return day 4 days later and still the owner was not there to receive the camper so no in paper work was completed like he was supposed to do per rvshare rules. 3 days later I received an email from rvshare stating that owner found nothing wrong with the camper and was releasing my security deposit of $500 back to me and that this transaction was completed. A couple of weeks later I receive an email from rvshare that the owner filed a claim for damages and I was asked by rvshare what kind of damage there was. I didn't know of any damage. The only thing was that my wife found a piece of plastic molding on the floor when we picked it up. That was it. On Oct 10th I received an email from rvshare that they were charging my credit card $398 for damages. I looked at my credit card account and there was a pending charge for that amount. I immediately called a Claims adjuster for rvshare and she explained that was for some sort of damages when i had the camper. I had to pay for insurance when I rented the camper. Company policy. She never did tell me what the $398 was for and I never did revieve any claims paperwork showing what I was paying $398 for. I told her that I was cleared by the owner on Sept 5th and my security deposit was returned. She told me that there could be more charges later. I asked for what and she couldn't tell me. Later that afternoon I received an email from her saying this account has been closed. I called my credit card company and had my card locked and closed in case anymore fraudulent transactions occurred. I will never ever deal with this company again.

I rented a camper in OK in Sept 2024 for 4 days. First of all when I went to pick up this camper, the owner never showed up to do the out paperwork to go over any damage before I rented it. No brake lights , no turn signal. I drove it away anyway because I already paid for it and there was no time to find another one. I returned the camper on the return day 4 days later and still the owner was not there to receive the camper so no in paper work was completed like he was supposed to do per rvshare rules. 3 days later I received an email from rvshare stating that owner found nothing wrong with the camper and was releasing my security deposit of $500 back to me and that this transaction was completed. A couple of weeks later I receive an email from rvshare that the owner filed a claim for damages and I was asked by rvshare what kind of damage there was. I didn't know of any damage. The only thing was that my wife found a piece of plastic molding on the floor when we picked it up. That was it. On Oct 10th I received an email from rvshare that they were charging my credit card $398 for damages. I looked at my credit card account and there was a pending charge for that amount. I immediately called a Claims adjuster for rvshare and she explained that was for some sort of damages when i had the camper. I had to pay for insurance when I rented the camper. Company policy. She never did tell me what the $398 was for and I never did revieve any claims paperwork showing what I was paying $398 for. I told her that I was cleared by the owner on Sept 5th and my security deposit was returned. She told me that there could be more charges later. I asked for what and she couldn't tell me. Later that afternoon I received an email from her saying this account has been closed. name: Tawana Marable
title: The Worst!!!!
text: The Worst!!!!This was the worst experience that I’ve ever had renting a vehicle. I reserved a 15 passenger van in Las Vegas for 5 days. When I arrived at the rental office, the lady there was less than thrilled to see me. She didn’t even acknowledge me as I waited. Whatever happened to good customer service? She tried to push expensive, and extra insurance on me. It got to the point that I had to call my agent on her day off to prove to her that I was covered. I guess my word wasn’t good enough. Although I rented a 15 passenger, I ended up with a 12 passenger van. I settled for that, but I wish that it was clean. The seats were so nasty , that we had to put plastic bags down to sit down. The seats were also torn and raggedy. It was very dirty. I also thought that most rentals start you off with a full tank of gas. Not in this case. It was below half. I went back in to complain and ask for a different vehicle. She stated that that was all that they had, and wasn’t apologetic at all. If it wasn’t peak season, and my family of 11 wasn’t depending on that for transportation, I would have left that work van right there. When I spend my hard earned money for something, I expect to be treated with respect. She didn’t even pretend to care. I will never ever rent from AVR Las Vegas again

name: Diana Castro
title: Horrible service from start to finish
text: Horrible service from start to finish.  The front desk person was very disrespectful and made racist comments.  The van was old and smelly. The tank was almost empty. The poor van almost doesn’t make it back because the engine was dying. The windshields didn’t work and made a squeaky sound. We came back to return the van and the same guy who rented it to us said he couldn’t gave us back the deposit.Lesson learned, never pay too cheap!!  Is better the extra cost for good customer service and safety.

name: Jeff Aucoin
title: I will never rent from AVR again
text: Where do I start??  I rented an AVR van in Houston to take a trip with my family.  When I arrived at the location on the scheduled pick up time the van was dirty inside and out.  The employee told me he needed to clean it inside.  After a 45 minute wait outside, he asked me if I wanted him to wash the outside.  I told him I would take care of it at home before my trip.  We confirmed weekly rates, free mileage etc.  When I returned the van, I delivered it clean inside and out without damage.  The employee told me that there would be approximately $1,000 additional mileage charge because I lived in Houston and the free mileage was only if you lived out of town.  This was never told to me or agreed to prior to me renting.      He told me I could dispute it with customer service and that he would leave the ticket open.  I finally got customer service on the phone, had to dispute the whole thing with them and my credit card company.  They had also falsely represented that I turned the van in 4 days after I did.  We finally settled on payment 2 months later after many emails and phone calls.  Today, nearly 6 months later I received a call that they are making a broken windshield claim against me.  That raggedy van has probably been rented a hundred times since I returned it and now this.I will never rent from that run down old place again.  I should have known something was bad when the couple checking out in front of me was arguing about their rental problems.

name: Lorenia Sojo Mesa
title: The worst customer service that I ever…
text: The worst customer service that I ever see, Never rent a car there. Bad policies, expensive insurance and bad customer service.

name: Bruce Seghers
title: Poor Customer Service
text: On 11/9/2020 Rented a van from AVR Las Vegas.  We needed a 12 Passenger van.First impression of the office/staff was not the best.  Very dirty and run down Staff made us feel like we were bothering them.  I videoed the entire vehicle as someone was writing down what I saw. Windshield cracked, dents all over. Seats dirty etc...  Van did not have full tank of gas, it was dirty on the inside.   When I turned the paper work in I commented on the windshield and the van did not have a full tank.  She was more concerned I initialed all the spots on the form to accept responsibility. I had a feeling that something was going to bite me when I left. 11/13/2020 The day I turned the van in.  I received an e mail that they sent a claim in for a cracked windshield.  Which they say was not on the form.  So I respond to the email, that they are mistaken and sent them a picture of the windshield with crack circles, and my number for someone to call meI called the following Monday because I had not received a response to my email.  The person at the LV office said that person would call me Tuesday due to her day off.  Nothing Tuesday.  Wednesday I send another e mail. This is the email I received11/18/2020Hello,The inspection Agent only had to report the damage. If or when the claims department contacts you, you can then dispute the claim with them.Thank you.Not a name not anything.  I have to wait?So maybe at some time in the future The claims department may or may not call me.I will not go into detail of the drivability of the van.The vehicle served its purpose.Customer service goes MILES.  It leaves a lasting impression.Everyone makes mistakes maybe the windshield crack was missed by the person inspecting the van prior to me.  It is possible.If someone would have called me or even given a little more info in an e mail.  I would have never written this review.I will never use AVR again. Mainly because of the Customer Service.

name: Jessica Fuentes
title: Rent anywhere else BUT here!
text: Rented a van a month ahead of time for a family trip to Denver. Our flight was late but we noticed shuttles for all other companies running every 5 to 10 mins. Never saw one from AVR. After waiting almost an hour I called the number on my reservation to see what was going on. They took another half hour to answer. The person who answered claimed he was not in Denver anymore and that they had tried to call me half an hour before my plane lamded. I was obviously on a plane when they tried to call. He basically said no one was coming because their offices had already closed. It was about 3:55pm when he said that to me. Luckily I had not made any prepayment. I quickly booked another van with Budget rentals on my phone, got my family on the next Budget shuttle bus and Budget took excellent care of us. It was a brand new van with plenty of space. From what I've read on other reviews I'm glad it worked out that way since I've read horror stories about the condition of AVR vans. Frankly I'm surprised they are still in business. If I see anyone waiting for AVR at the airport next time. I will be sure to warn them of the terrible service they are about to receive. Seriously if this is the cheapest option you found, take the next cheapest. ANYONE would be better than this company!

name: tammy tran
title: STAY AWAY FROM AIRPORT VAN RENTAL!
text: DON'T BE A VICTIM LIKE ME.  DO NOT RENT FROM THEM AT ALL!  STAY AWAY FROM AIRPORT VAN RENTAL!If there are negative or 0 ratings for this business, I would give it to them.  We rented a mini van with AVR for a family trip.   After spending two hrs on inspecting the vehicle and on the phone with the corporate office, we decided not to pick up the van due health and safety/liability concerns with the following reasons:1. The van has many exterior and interior damages such as cracked windshield, damaged sliding doors, loose seat cover, many scratches, and dents all over the van.   I didn't want to put my family at risk driving such van.2. There were dirt and sand all over the inside of the van. AVR policy said they will charge you if they find sand in the vehicle.  The van wasn't clean properly as AVR stated on their website "commitment to safety."I don't want to put my family at risk of getting COVID-19 virus due to unclean vehicle.3. The van had 'Engine Check' light on.  The Clerk said to the corporate office people when they were on the phone with me that no repair has been done since the beginning the COVID-19 pandemic due to budget cuts. That means the vans are not properly maintained/serviced for long-distance travel.4. Odometers were not functioning properly. How do we keep track of the miles so that it will not exceed the 3000 mile limit?5. The clerk showed us 3 other vans but they were a lot worse than the reserved one.I spent 2 hours on the phone with the corporate office on the pickup day, but couldn't even come to an agreement nor able to talk to the manager at all.I emailed, Marcus with airportvanrental.com, to refund my money but they wouldn't respond back.    It's been almost 2 months already, but haven't heard from them.I filed a dispute with my credit card company.  AVR responded that "customer didn't show up to pick up the vehicle."   Where I actually came with the intension to pick up the van.My intention for this review is for future customers to learn from my incidence with AVR.  I hope AVR is reading my review and change their ways of doing business to put customer's safety as their priority.  Thank you for reading through my lengthen review.
