They offered to sell me insurance which was $35 a DAY, more than the cost of the van rental!!! The lady at the desk, Anna, is a total nightmare. She pulled a bait a switch. They get you to rent a big passenger van but when you get to the counter, they make it impossible for you to take without all of this extra paperwork- so after 2 hrs., you give up and pay extra for a smaller car just to get out of there. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE...it is the worst customer service and scam I have ever seen. No one cares there either.

name: C  Gasulla
title: SCAM FROM BEGINNING TO END
text: On Feb 13th 2020 I rented a vehicle ( reservation made few months in advanced at AVR Van Rental ( LAX Branch California )To make the long story short, I received a $800 bill for a 1/8 of an inch chip on the windshield, while I was told during the the time of pick up, not to worry and or describe anything larger than a quarter coin.I’m sure I’m not the only one who got SCAM with this situation and would like to make everyone aware of the type of business they do.They still holding $ 200 dollars from the time we sign the bill and refused to return the funds.

title: I "overpaid" so I can't check in!
text: I bought a ticket and paid for a seat, the seat didn't show up in the check-in process.I am not able to complete the check-in due to "overpayment".Wizz Air took my money, blocked my check-in, and refused to provide any support. Their bot sent me to Booking.com, Booking sent me back to them. I paid for a seat and was denied access to the flight. Scam-level business. Zero customer service. Avoid like the plague.

name: Michelle A
title: Absolute dogs bollocking breakfast of a…
text: Absolute dogs bollocking breakfast of a shambles. Appalling app website doesn’t work check-in doesn’t work and then you’re forced to check in at the airport that cost you upwards of €50. The whole thing is a con To loop you in with cheap flights that cost you the earth by the back door, and I won’t ever be using Wizz Air again.

name: George Bejenariu
title: No control over my data
text: After 50 minutes of waiting on the line with excelent music interrupted by an annoying voice telling me how long I still have to wait every 30 seconds as if I don't have a watch:"-You cannot change your email.-What if I lose access to my email or someone else takes control over it?-You can delete your account.-Won't I need to confirm deletion over email?-....."So I will just ask them to delete my account.For an european company, they do things in a pretty american way.In conclusion, just play the music...

name: Simon from London
title: SCANDALOUS CHARGES FOR CUSTOMER SERIVCES
text: THIS MUST BE CRIMINAL? I was travelling to Czech republic with my son in February. My price included airport check-in and I had a simple quesion about my passport. I phoned the company (twice) on 28th January, and was given the right advice. BUT... for these TWO BRIEF PHONE CALLS most of which I was on hold I was charged £41.35!!!!! I could have upgraded my flight options for that, paid for my luggage, or whatever! Nowhere was I alerted to the fact this was a premium rate call, and for a basic short call to customer services, most of which on hold, it is a scandal. I will definitely try to avoid this airline in future. BE WARNED.

name: Mayuri
title: Abhorrent airline
text: Abhorrent airline. Never flying with them again. They make sure that it’s essentially impossible to contact them. Lying when checking-in. Website not optimised for use so that you download their stupid app.

name: Valeria dello Russo
title: Refund never received. Treated like garbage by customer service.
text: My flight was cancelled on April 28 due to a massive outage between Spain and Portugal. I followed the refund procedure as instructed, received multiple confirmation emails saying my refund (as WIZZ credits) had been processed.Guess what? It was a lie. No refund. No credits. No trace of anything in my WIZZ account.Today I contacted customer service after waiting 30 minutes on hold. The agent was rude, ignorant, incompetent, impatient, and literally told me “so?? so??” while I tried to find my flight number — then HUNG UP on me. No help. No resolution. Nothing.Wizz Air is not just incompetent — it’s disrespectful, abusive, and completely unreliable.They cancel your flight and keep the money, **you are not a low-cost airline. You are thieves.**Avoid Wizz Air unless you enjoy being insulted while begging for your own money.DON'T FLY WIZZAIR, AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS!!

name: Ugo Agwu
title: Horrible Customer Service.
text: Horrible airline. Advertised that I can buy extra baggage online and then didn’t allow to me pay online. Got to the desk they charged me £70 then destroyed/ damaged my luggage Called the customer service on my return after 1 hour they answered as I was explaining my frustration they  cut me off and said make a claim online and cut the phone off on me. What a horrible experience and to be treated like you are nothing.

name: jay t
title: They are the worst
text: They are the worst.So rudeCharge for anything.I wouldn’t use them but they are the only airline flying where we need to go. Would be great if a reputable company bought them out!

name: Seb
title: AVOID - BUY RYANAIR OR EASYJET INSTEAD!!!
text: Wizz air is by far the worst budget airline around. They artificially inflate plane prices while you book, panic you into buying tickets at a higher price than they should cost, before lowering them a few days later for the next customer. Their flights are very often in my experience as a frequent flyer, delayed, very strict with bag sizing which adds to the delays, and the customer service is beyond abysmal - they don’t even have a standard complaints email! And if you dare to make a complaint, you probably stand a 1% chance of any refund or the slightest bit of action taken because Wizz Air is a business solely driven by money. When I eventually found a way to submit my complaint about their artificial price hiking and then lowering after I bought the ticket, they gave an automated reply and closed the case without even an apology. I’d recommend flying ryanair or easyJet if you can avoid Wizz, or spend a little extra on a more luxury airline and avoid the countless problems Wizzair gives you.Overall very disappointing.

name: Vlora Hasani
title: I write 2 E-Mails and they never…
text: I write 2 E-Mails and they never respond to it. I just got a case number with an auto message.NEVER again. They don't care when u need them.

name: John
title: Changed flight times…
text: My flight to Istanbul was changed to later times both outbound and return. This was several weeks after booking when prices at other airlines had increased or unavailable for my dates. Unacceptable.

name: Aaron Nguyen
title: The worst and rudest flight attendance…
text: The worst and rudest flight attendance I have ever encountered in my 25+ years of flying. Wizz really need to train their staff better and recruit those with a little more empathy & understanding. On a flight from Luton to Tromso the head stewardess Roxanne (refused to give me her last name for obvious reasons) has to be the worst example of a flight attendant. 1 min after entering the toilet the the turbulence sign was switched on, and there was frantic knocking from the other side. After another minute or two there was further frantic knocking on the door. Do they not understand that 1. Passengers in there can see the the turbulence light is on 2. Even if I didn't I can definitely feel it 3. I was trying to finish quickly but when nature calls you can not rush these things. Worst thing was when I came out as quickly as possible she literally just barked at me "Fasten you seat belt". I didn't even have time to get to my seat. When I tried to explain you can't hurry people especially when they just got in, she ignored me and just barked again "get back to your seat and fasten your seat belt" like I had done something wrong!!! Then at the end of the flight when I asked for her name she was the most obnoxious flight attendant I've ever had to deal with. I understand she was training someone and was trying to look authorative. Just demonstrated what a terrible flight attendant and human being she was. Moral to all flight attendants, let passengers have a dump in peace they know they need to get out asap and rest assured don't want to be caught in there during turbulance either. Wizz Air train your staff to be empathic, understanding and if passengers have something to say let them feel like they've been heard, it's the basics of customer service!!!!

name: Amal Ramadan
title: Even one star not deserved-worst Airlines ever
text: Even one star not deserved, the worst unprofessional staff ever.They denied our boarding because of their ignorance and lack of knowledge of visa regulations.And guess what a friend of us travelled next week using wizzair going for the same destination and had the same situation as us and they made him and his familly get boarding despite his kids didn't have a visa.they were able to get visa on arrival.that what I was trying to explain to the staff that we are resident in the uk and are able to get visa on arrival to enter Saudi Arabia.they completely dismissed my explanation and were very rigid with us.The staff called the security for us as we are criminals, I am a doctor and was very sure if visa regulations before booking the tickets. They did not handle the situation sensibly as they should.I had to go back all the way from london to the north of England (around 250 miles) without any compensation or money return or even explaining what will be the next step. I lost a big sum of money, they broke my children's hearts who didn't travel for almost 3 years. And destroyed all my family dream to gather. It was my daughter's birthday to finally gather and celebrate. I will never travel ot book with them again.even if it is free , I  will tell everyone I know about my experience to avoid dealing with you.

name: Mihai Laurentiu
title: Most miserable company!Whitout my…
text: Most miserable company!Whitout my consent they changed my sest place from 2A which I payed extra money to 37 A.Nothing about any compensation!During the past they cancelled as well the flight ,just let me know with 6 hours before the flight!Avoid this dodgy company!

name: Andy Hartley
title: Booked a flight with WizzAir that did…
text: Booked a flight with WizzAir that did not exist. Leaving me to pay hundreds of pounds more to get a flight last minute for the next day, plus extra hotel costs. They have ignored every message I have sent them regarding this issue. Their customer service is awful.

name: PM
title: Horrible
text: Horrible, apparently the website automatically chooses that you will check in online and if you don’t they charge you 45 Euro Thank you for giving me a heads up on that. absolutely not good

name: Sarah Vafai
title: Beware
text: Beware – This Company Is a ScamI strongly advise against using this company. It’s nearly impossible to reach a live customer service representative by phone, and communication overall is extremely difficult. text: My flight to Istanbul was changed to later times both outbound and return. This was several weeks after booking when prices at other airlines had increased or unavailable for my dates. Unacceptable.

name: Aaron Nguyen
title: The worst and rudest flight attendance…
text: The worst and rudest flight attendance I have ever encountered in my 25+ years of flying. Wizz really need to train their staff better and recruit those with a little more empathy & understanding. On a flight from Luton to Tromso the head stewardess Roxanne (refused to give me her last name for obvious reasons) has to be the worst example of a flight attendant. 1 min after entering the toilet the the turbulence sign was switched on, and there was frantic knocking from the other side. After another minute or two there was further frantic knocking on the door. Do they not understand that 1. Passengers in there can see the the turbulence light is on 2. Even if I didn't I can definitely feel it 3. I was trying to finish quickly but when nature calls you can not rush these things. Worst thing was when I came out as quickly as possible she literally just barked at me "Fasten you seat belt". I didn't even have time to get to my seat. When I tried to explain you can't hurry people especially when they just got in, she ignored me and just barked again "get back to your seat and fasten your seat belt" like I had done something wrong!!! Then at the end of the flight when I asked for her name she was the most obnoxious flight attendant I've ever had to deal with. I understand she was training someone and was trying to look authorative. Just demonstrated what a terrible flight attendant and human being she was. Moral to all flight attendants, let passengers have a dump in peace they know they need to get out asap and rest assured don't want to be caught in there during turbulance either. Wizz Air train your staff to be empathic, understanding and if passengers have something to say let them feel like they've been heard, it's the basics of customer service!!!!

name: Amal Ramadan
title: Even one star not deserved-worst Airlines ever
text: Even one star not deserved, the worst unprofessional staff ever.They denied our boarding because of their ignorance and lack of knowledge of visa regulations.And guess what a friend of us travelled next week using wizzair going for the same destination and had the same situation as us and they made him and his familly get boarding despite his kids didn't have a visa.they were able to get visa on arrival.that what I was trying to explain to the staff that we are resident in the uk and are able to get visa on arrival to enter Saudi Arabia.they completely dismissed my explanation and were very rigid with us.The staff called the security for us as we are criminals, I am a doctor and was very sure if visa regulations before booking the tickets. They did not handle the situation sensibly as they should.I had to go back all the way from london to the north of England (around 250 miles) without any compensation or money return or even explaining what will be the next step. I lost a big sum of money, they broke my children's hearts who didn't travel for almost 3 years. And destroyed all my family dream to gather. It was my daughter's birthday to finally gather and celebrate. I will never travel ot book with them again.even if it is free , I  will tell everyone I know about my experience to avoid dealing with you.

name: Andy Hartley
title: Booked a flight with WizzAir that did…

title: Horrible
text: Horrible, apparently the website automatically chooses that you will check in online and if you don’t they charge you 45 Euro Thank you for giving me a heads up on that. absolutely not good

name: Sarah Vafai
title: Beware
text: Beware – This Company Is a ScamI strongly advise against using this company. It’s nearly impossible to reach a live customer service representative by phone, and communication overall is extremely difficult. They also tend to add unexpected charges if you're not paying close attention.We booked a flight from Barcelona to Rome through them and purchased two tickets—one with a 20kg luggage allowance and the other with 26kg. Both suitcases were identical in size. We redistributed our items so that one bag weighed exactly 20kg and the other 24kg.In a rush at the airport and without Wi-Fi access, I didn’t double-check the baggage allowances on our tickets. At check-in, we were charged 60 euros for the second bag supposedly being 4kg over the 20kg limit. After passing security and finally connecting to Wi-Fi, I reviewed our tickets and confirmed that the second bag was actually allowed 26kg.I immediately ran back to the check-in desk. The agent acknowledged the mistake and admitted we were wrongly charged—but said the only way to get a refund was by submitting a claim online.Since returning home, I’ve tried repeatedly to reach someone to resolve the issue—there is no live customer service. I submitted all the necessary documentation by email, and their response was baffling: they rejected my claim, stating the luggage was "oversized."How does that make sense? Both bags were exactly the same size. If the 20kg bag was accepted without issue, how could the identical 24kg bag suddenly be "oversized"?This company lacks common sense and customer support. I strongly urge others to avoid booking with them.

title: Amazing experience as a young solo traveler!
text: I have been flying with Wizz Air from the age of 14 (solo). The staff was always kind and looked after me well. title: AVOID - BUY RYANAIR OR EASYJET INSTEAD!!!

name: Aaron Nguyen
title: The worst and rudest flight attendance…
text: The worst and rudest flight attendance I have ever encountered in my 25+ years of flying. Wizz really need to train their staff better and recruit those with a little more empathy & understanding. On a flight from Luton to Tromso the head stewardess Roxanne (refused to give me her last name for obvious reasons) has to be the worst example of a flight attendant. 1 min after entering the toilet the the turbulence sign was switched on, and there was frantic knocking from the other side. After another minute or two there was further frantic knocking on the door. Do they not understand that 1. Passengers in there can see the the turbulence light is on 2. Even if I didn't I can definitely feel it 3. I was trying to finish quickly but when nature calls you can not rush these things. Worst thing was when I came out as quickly as possible she literally just barked at me "Fasten you seat belt". I didn't even have time to get to my seat. When I tried to explain you can't hurry people especially when they just got in, she ignored me and just barked again "get back to your seat and fasten your seat belt" like I had done something wrong!!! Then at the end of the flight when I asked for her name she was the most obnoxious flight attendant I've ever had to deal with. I understand she was training someone and was trying to look authorative. Just demonstrated what a terrible flight attendant and human being she was. Moral to all flight attendants, let passengers have a dump in peace they know they need to get out asap and rest assured don't want to be caught in there during turbulance either. Wizz Air train your staff to be empathic, understanding and if passengers have something to say let them feel like they've been heard, it's the basics of customer service!!!!

name: Sarah Vafai
title: Beware
text: Beware – This Company Is a ScamI strongly advise against using this company. It’s nearly impossible to reach a live customer service representative by phone, and communication overall is extremely difficult. They also tend to add unexpected charges if you're not paying close attention.We booked a flight from Barcelona to Rome through them and purchased two tickets—one with a 20kg luggage allowance and the other with 26kg. Both suitcases were identical in size. We redistributed our items so that one bag weighed exactly 20kg and the other 24kg.In a rush at the airport and without Wi-Fi access, I didn’t double-check the baggage allowances on our tickets. At check-in, we were charged 60 euros for the second bag supposedly being 4kg over the 20kg limit. After passing security and finally connecting to Wi-Fi, I reviewed our tickets and confirmed that the second bag was actually allowed 26kg.I immediately ran back to the check-in desk. The agent acknowledged the mistake and admitted we were wrongly charged—but said the only way to get a refund was by submitting a claim online.Since returning home, I’ve tried repeatedly to reach someone to resolve the issue—there is no live customer service. I submitted all the necessary documentation by email, and their response was baffling: they rejected my claim, stating the luggage was "oversized."How does that make sense? Both bags were exactly the same size. If the 20kg bag was accepted without issue, how could the identical 24kg bag suddenly be "oversized"?This company lacks common sense and customer support. I strongly urge others to avoid booking with them.

name: Sarah Vafai
title: Beware
text: Beware – This Company Is a ScamI strongly advise against using this company. It’s nearly impossible to reach a live customer service representative by phone, and communication overall is extremely difficult. They also tend to add unexpected charges if you're not paying close attention.We booked a flight from Barcelona to Rome through them and purchased two tickets—one with a 20kg luggage allowance and the other with 26kg. Both suitcases were identical in size. We redistributed our items so that one bag weighed exactly 20kg and the other 24kg.In a rush at the airport and without Wi-Fi access, I didn’t double-check the baggage allowances on our tickets. At check-in, we were charged 60 euros for the second bag supposedly being 4kg over the 20kg limit. After passing security and finally connecting to Wi-Fi, I reviewed our tickets and confirmed that the second bag was actually allowed 26kg.I immediately ran back to the check-in desk. The agent acknowledged the mistake and admitted we were wrongly charged—but said the only way to get a refund was by submitting a claim online.Since returning home, I’ve tried repeatedly to reach someone to resolve the issue—there is no live customer service. I submitted all the necessary documentation by email, and their response was baffling: they rejected my claim, stating the luggage was "oversized."How does that make sense? Both bags were exactly the same size. If the 20kg bag was accepted without issue, how could the identical 24kg bag suddenly be "oversized"?This company lacks common sense and customer support. I strongly urge others to avoid booking with them.

name: Kim
title: CardelMar & Avis
text: Rented a car, but it broke down (Avis / Maggiore). It was brought to the nearest garage. I was promised an update later that day but didn't get any news. I had to leave for the airport the next day. I contacted the garage myself and I could pick up the car. When I arrived at the drop off point (Avis / Maggiore) they couldn't give me a refund for the time that I didn't have the car. CardelMar refused to do it either. Apparently it is mentioned in their policy. So if the car breaks down you don't have any story.This is what they have to say:Dear Mrs Comminne,The paragraph is the following:Please be aware that according to our Terms & Conditions ( Point 22 - Refund of Excess ) costs such as vehicle recovery fees, charges arising from the car hirer losing rental days due to repairs, service fees,administration fees, handling fees, hotels, survey fees, telephone charges etc. are not refunded.

title: I have used CarDelMar before and am very happy.

title: booking is very easy

name: Ronald B
title: Car del Mar fails in customer service and complaints
text: Update 18/10 : Finally complaint has been acknowledged by CarDelMar and part of the transaction is now refunded. Did cost a lot of hassle but glad that they now see that Easirent was 100 % wrong.------------------------------------------------------------------------------Car del Mar is not supporting their customers in case a provider is not able to offer the car type hired. I hired a car with automatic transmission (which is far more expensive) and the supplier was not able to fulfil this.I send a complaint and first reaction was to get a partial refund. However when supplier was not honouring this they said I got the car type I rented.But I have photo proof and British Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency clearly shows that car I got was not an automatic car.They now try to get away with their terms and conditions which is not correct.PSeasirent Luton, never use these supplier. Car del Mar, it would be a good thing if you stop using this company, as this is not their first complaint.

title: Unfortuneately I could not choose minus…

I am a retired sales professional and have even been a trainer. DO NOT PAY THEIR CRAZY INSURANCE PRICE...LEAVE AND GO RENT IN THE MAIN BUILDING....SPREAD THE WORD!!!

name: Chris Severus
title: Cheating with car class !! take care!!
text: rented a car in Switzerland with Billiger Mietwagen de. for a 2 week period.The booked car was a medium SUV Ford Kuga (Escape) or similar. According to Photos on the website and on the voucher. What i received in Dubai was a compact Car Ford Ecosport. A very small uncomfortable car for a 1.90m tall person. (seat can not be changed in height etc)The local company is working only with the 4 letter class code  which was according to them the small car. we (customer) book according to presented Photos of the Model and Model Names but not according to codes.The 2 Models can never be defined as similar !! After complaining I only got excuses and bla bla .. but no chance for a change to a car similar as booked. According to the local rental company it is common system of Cardelmar. They are really angry because they have to deal with many disappointed and angry customers booked with cardelmar as a broker.

name: Louise
title: What a disaster with this company
text: What a disaster with this company.  We arrived in Ibiza (flight was delayed) and had taken out all the insurances with CarDelMar, when we arrived we had to take additional insurances for airport tax, which we already had paid to CarDelMar, we now have an extra cost of  €124.15.  I called  CarDelMar, who told that was our own problem and we should read the conditions carefully..  Unbelievable, if we had not paid the extra insurance they would not give us the car.   DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT THEIR LOYAL CUSTOMERS

name: Joe Simon
title: I forgot my driver's license so…
text: I forgot my driver's license so couldn't rent (Calgary). I called to cancel but was told it was too late, which is fine, since it was on the first day of rental. When I asked them if they would at least reimburse me for half the rental period (4 days total) they declined and charged me for all 4 days, That is greedy business. A normal company charges only the first day for a no-show. I offered paying for 2 days. They took all the money without any consideration of the circumstances. Their approach is if that's what the contract says, who cares about the customer. Just money hungry with no consideration for the human being. Bad business. Next time, I will pay a few more dollars and use a normal company.

name: Marco Na
title: Fuel deposit not charged back
text: Fuel deposit was fully charged by Centauro Aeropuerto Palma de Mallorca even though the fuel arrangement was "full-full" and the Car was returns with full tank and deposit for fuel should have beencharged back. But now I wait since over three month for charge back.Untrustworthy Car Rental!

name: Marcel Pradella
title: Stay away it's a rip off
text: Stay away it's a rip offThe actual car rental company will try to charge you as much as they can for additional insurances, extended rental time or anything like that. I booked with a car with All-inclusive-comprehensive car insurance for 17 days at a total cost 453.18Euro. When I picked up the car at the airport I was told that they won't accept my mastercard debit (same card that I paid with before) for the deposit unless I get an additional comprehensive insurance that cost 618.80Euro. I urgently needed the car and they refused to give it to me unless I'd pay the additional amount plus a 250.00 Euro deposit. So I had to pay 1071.36Euro plus deposit instead of the promised 453.18Euro. I'm not the only one. It's a rip off. Check other reviews very carefully and stay away.

When I asked them if they would at least reimburse me for half the rental period (4 days total) they declined and charged me for all 4 days, That is greedy business. A normal company charges only the first day for a no-show. I offered paying for 2 days. They took all the money without any consideration of the circumstances. Their approach is if that's what the contract says, who cares about the customer. Just money hungry with no consideration for the human being. Bad business. Next time, I will pay a few more dollars and use a normal company.

title: Fuel deposit not charged back

name: Kim
title: CardelMar & Avis
text: Rented a car, but it broke down (Avis / Maggiore). It was brought to the nearest garage. I was promised an update later that day but didn't get any news. I had to leave for the airport the next day. I contacted the garage myself and I could pick up the car. title: Car del Mar fails in customer service and complaints
text: Update 18/10 : Finally complaint has been acknowledged by CarDelMar and part of the transaction is now refunded. name: Breed
title: Excellent rental car broker
text: Cardelmar has an easy website, good prices and excellent customer service. I booked a car with insurance at Cardelmar. I sent all the information they needed and they processed my claim within 4 days.Wow! That's what I call good service.

name: Rodrigo Perez
title: Very bad services (4 times more expensive at the end)
text: Very bad service.CarDelMar does not show the terms and conditions of the suppliers. They provide a final bill and even if I stated the situation of my arrival to them I needed to pay almost four times more when I got to the car rental.Much better to use other company.

name: Andries Telgenhof
title: Very bad service at Sicilie
text: Very bad service at Sicilië !Not the reservated car, much problems at the Office With documents.Cardelmar doesn’t answer phonecalls to solve problems.Advice, never rent a car at cardelmar!!

name: Kim
title: CardelMar & Avis
text: Rented a car, but it broke down (Avis / Maggiore). It was brought to the nearest garage. I was promised an update later that day but didn't get any news. I had to leave for the airport the next day. I contacted the garage myself and I could pick up the car. When I arrived at the drop off point (Avis / Maggiore) they couldn't give me a refund for the time that I didn't have the car. CardelMar refused to do it either. Apparently it is mentioned in their policy. So if the car breaks down you don't have any story.This is what they have to say:Dear Mrs Comminne,The paragraph is the following:Please be aware that according to our Terms & Conditions ( Point 22 - Refund of Excess ) costs such as vehicle recovery fees, charges arising from the car hirer losing rental days due to repairs, service fees,administration fees, handling fees, hotels, survey fees, telephone charges etc. are not refunded.

name: Remco de Jong
title: I have used CarDelMar before and am very happy.
text: I have used CarDelMar before and was 100% satisfied. Got a very sharp price and even then an upgrade.They are clear and reasonable on the insurance policy; and all information is clear. Thanks for the service.

name: the booker
title: booking is very easy
text: booking is very easy and i never felt something like "dynamic pricing". i use cardelmar a lot for travels and the service was alway perfect. By the way, best pricing.

name: Ronald B
title: Car del Mar fails in customer service and complaints
text: Update 18/10 : Finally complaint has been acknowledged by CarDelMar and part of the transaction is now refunded. Did cost a lot of hassle but glad that they now see that Easirent was 100 % wrong.------------------------------------------------------------------------------Car del Mar is not supporting their customers in case a provider is not able to offer the car type hired. I hired a car with automatic transmission (which is far more expensive) and the supplier was not able to fulfil this.I send a complaint and first reaction was to get a partial refund. However when supplier was not honouring this they said I got the car type I rented.But I have photo proof and British Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency clearly shows that car I got was not an automatic car.They now try to get away with their terms and conditions which is not correct.PSeasirent Luton, never use these supplier. Car del Mar, it would be a good thing if you stop using this company, as this is not their first complaint.

name: Smith
title: Unfortuneately I could not choose minus…
text: Unfortuneately I could not choose minus stars! I would highly not recomend  renting from this company. I have traveled around the entire world and often with rental autos. This was the absolute worst expierience and it is not in a third world country but in beautiful Sardegna.The staff is totaly unfriendly and if it does not go their way they will just tell you to leave or hang up on you wich I witnessed at least 15 times in the 20 minutes I wasted in their crappy office...I wonder why or who for a customer that the front door is totally smashed in.  I am a retired sales professional and have even been a trainer. THESE PEOPLE ARE HIGHLY TRAINED INSURANSE SALE PERSONS NOT RENTAL CARS...my car costed only 90 euros with insurance plus I travel with a travelers visa that covers the entire cost of Any Damage...because I would not pay an additional 250 euros for their insurance they are trained to sale...Like many other customers I was a stranded tourist alone with my 17 month old child tired, hungry, and with out an auto to reach my destination. I thankfully spend quite a bit of time in Sardegna. It is a wonderful place to visit as long as you steer clear of this Gold rental cars Olbia...Cardelmar. Your bargain car will be smaller than agreed and cost you more than a luxury auto by the normal vendors. DO NOT PAY THEIR CRAZY INSURANCE PRICE...LEAVE AND GO RENT IN THE MAIN BUILDING....SPREAD THE WORD!!!

name: Chris Severus
title: Cheating with car class !! take care!!
text: rented a car in Switzerland with Billiger Mietwagen de. for a 2 week period.The booked car was a medium SUV Ford Kuga (Escape) or similar. According to Photos on the website and on the voucher. What i received in Dubai was a compact Car Ford Ecosport. A very small uncomfortable car for a 1.90m tall person. (seat can not be changed in height etc)The local company is working only with the 4 letter class code  which was according to them the small car. we (customer) book according to presented Photos of the Model and Model Names but not according to codes.The 2 Models can never be defined as similar !! After complaining I only got excuses and bla bla .. but no chance for a change to a car similar as booked. According to the local rental company it is common system of Cardelmar. They are really angry because they have to deal with many disappointed and angry customers booked with cardelmar as a broker.

name: Louise
title: What a disaster with this company
text: What a disaster with this company.  We arrived in Ibiza (flight was delayed) and had taken out all the insurances with CarDelMar, when we arrived we had to take additional insurances for airport tax, which we already had paid to CarDelMar, we now have an extra cost of  €124.15.  I called  CarDelMar, who told that was our own problem and we should read the conditions carefully..  Unbelievable, if we had not paid the extra insurance they would not give us the car.   DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT THEIR LOYAL CUSTOMERS

name: Joe Simon
title: I forgot my driver's license so…
text: I forgot my driver's license so couldn't rent (Calgary). I called to cancel but was told it was too late, which is fine, since it was on the first day of rental. When I asked them if they would at least reimburse me for half the rental period (4 days total) they declined and charged me for all 4 days, That is greedy business. A normal company charges only the first day for a no-show. I offered paying for 2 days. They took all the money without any consideration of the circumstances. Their approach is if that's what the contract says, who cares about the customer. Just money hungry with no consideration for the human being. Bad business. Next time, I will pay a few more dollars and use a normal company.

name: Marco Na
title: Fuel deposit not charged back
text: Fuel deposit was fully charged by Centauro Aeropuerto Palma de Mallorca even though the fuel arrangement was "full-full" and the Car was returns with full tank and deposit for fuel should have beencharged back. But now I wait since over three month for charge back.Untrustworthy Car Rental!

name: Marcel Pradella
title: Stay away it's a rip off
text: Stay away it's a rip offThe actual car rental company will try to charge you as much as they can for additional insurances, extended rental time or anything like that. I booked with a car with All-inclusive-comprehensive car insurance for 17 days at a total cost 453.18Euro. When I picked up the car at the airport I was told that they won't accept my mastercard debit (same card that I paid with before) for the deposit unless I get an additional comprehensive insurance that cost 618.80Euro. I urgently needed the car and they refused to give it to me unless I'd pay the additional amount plus a 250.00 Euro deposit. So I had to pay 1071.36Euro plus deposit instead of the promised 453.18Euro. I'm not the only one. It's a rip off. Check other reviews very carefully and stay away.

The car rental company sent me a bill for damage to a side mirror the day after I returned the car. I contacted Cardelmar customer service, they replied within one day. I sent all the information they needed and they processed my claim within 4 days.Wow! That's what I call good service.

name: Rodrigo Perez
title: Very bad services (4 times more expensive at the end)
text: Very bad service.CarDelMar does not show the terms and conditions of the suppliers. They provide a final bill and even if I stated the situation of my arrival to them I needed to pay almost four times more when I got to the car rental.Much better to use other company.

name: Andries Telgenhof
title: Very bad service at Sicilie
text: Very bad service at Sicilië !Not the reservated car, much problems at the Office With documents.Cardelmar doesn’t answer phonecalls to solve problems.Advice, never rent a car at cardelmar!!

name: Kim
title: CardelMar & Avis
text: Rented a car, but it broke down (Avis / Maggiore). It was brought to the nearest garage. I was promised an update later that day but didn't get any news. I had to leave for the airport the next day. I contacted the garage myself and I could pick up the car. When I arrived at the drop off point (Avis / Maggiore) they couldn't give me a refund for the time that I didn't have the car. CardelMar refused to do it either. Apparently it is mentioned in their policy. So if the car breaks down you don't have any story.This is what they have to say:Dear Mrs Comminne,The paragraph is the following:Please be aware that according to our Terms & Conditions ( Point 22 - Refund of Excess ) costs such as vehicle recovery fees, charges arising from the car hirer losing rental days due to repairs, service fees,administration fees, handling fees, hotels, survey fees, telephone charges etc. are not refunded.

name: Remco de Jong
title: I have used CarDelMar before and am very happy.
text: I have used CarDelMar before and was 100% satisfied. Got a very sharp price and even then an upgrade.They are clear and reasonable on the insurance policy; and all information is clear. Thanks for the service.

name: the booker
title: booking is very easy
text: booking is very easy and i never felt something like "dynamic pricing". i use cardelmar a lot for travels and the service was alway perfect. By the way, best pricing.

name: Ronald B
title: Car del Mar fails in customer service and complaints
text: Update 18/10 : Finally complaint has been acknowledged by CarDelMar and part of the transaction is now refunded. Did cost a lot of hassle but glad that they now see that Easirent was 100 % wrong.------------------------------------------------------------------------------Car del Mar is not supporting their customers in case a provider is not able to offer the car type hired. I hired a car with automatic transmission (which is far more expensive) and the supplier was not able to fulfil this.I send a complaint and first reaction was to get a partial refund. However when supplier was not honouring this they said I got the car type I rented.But I have photo proof and British Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency clearly shows that car I got was not an automatic car.They now try to get away with their terms and conditions which is not correct.PSeasirent Luton, never use these supplier. Car del Mar, it would be a good thing if you stop using this company, as this is not their first complaint.

name: Smith
title: Unfortuneately I could not choose minus…

I am a retired sales professional and have even been a trainer. THESE PEOPLE ARE HIGHLY TRAINED INSURANSE SALE PERSONS NOT RENTAL CARS...my car costed only 90 euros with insurance plus I travel with a travelers visa that covers the entire cost of Any Damage...because I would not pay an additional 250 euros for their insurance they are trained to sale...Like many other customers I was a stranded tourist alone with my 17 month old child tired, hungry, and with out an auto to reach my destination. I thankfully spend quite a bit of time in Sardegna. It is a wonderful place to visit as long as you steer clear of this Gold rental cars Olbia...Cardelmar. Your bargain car will be smaller than agreed and cost you more than a luxury auto by the normal vendors. DO NOT PAY THEIR CRAZY INSURANCE PRICE...LEAVE AND GO RENT IN THE MAIN BUILDING....SPREAD THE WORD!!!

name: Chris Severus
title: Cheating with car class !! take care!!
text: rented a car in Switzerland with Billiger Mietwagen de. for a 2 week period.The booked car was a medium SUV Ford Kuga (Escape) or similar. According to Photos on the website and on the voucher. What i received in Dubai was a compact Car Ford Ecosport. A very small uncomfortable car for a 1.90m tall person. (seat can not be changed in height etc)The local company is working only with the 4 letter class code  which was according to them the small car. we (customer) book according to presented Photos of the Model and Model Names but not according to codes.The 2 Models can never be defined as similar !! After complaining I only got excuses and bla bla .. but no chance for a change to a car similar as booked. According to the local rental company it is common system of Cardelmar. They are really angry because they have to deal with many disappointed and angry customers booked with cardelmar as a broker.

name: Louise
title: What a disaster with this company
text: What a disaster with this company.  We arrived in Ibiza (flight was delayed) and had taken out all the insurances with CarDelMar, when we arrived we had to take additional insurances for airport tax, which we already had paid to CarDelMar, we now have an extra cost of  €124.15.  I called  CarDelMar, who told that was our own problem and we should read the conditions carefully..  Unbelievable, if we had not paid the extra insurance they would not give us the car.   DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT THEIR LOYAL CUSTOMERS

name: Joe Simon
title: I forgot my driver's license so…
text: I forgot my driver's license so couldn't rent (Calgary). I called to cancel but was told it was too late, which is fine, since it was on the first day of rental. When I asked them if they would at least reimburse me for half the rental period (4 days total) they declined and charged me for all 4 days, That is greedy business. A normal company charges only the first day for a no-show. I offered paying for 2 days. They took all the money without any consideration of the circumstances. Their approach is if that's what the contract says, who cares about the customer. Just money hungry with no consideration for the human being. Bad business. Next time, I will pay a few more dollars and use a normal company.

name: Marco Na
title: Fuel deposit not charged back
text: Fuel deposit was fully charged by Centauro Aeropuerto Palma de Mallorca even though the fuel arrangement was "full-full" and the Car was returns with full tank and deposit for fuel should have beencharged back. But now I wait since over three month for charge back.Untrustworthy Car Rental!

name: Marcel Pradella
title: Stay away it's a rip off
text: Stay away it's a rip offThe actual car rental company will try to charge you as much as they can for additional insurances, extended rental time or anything like that. I booked with a car with All-inclusive-comprehensive car insurance for 17 days at a total cost 453.18Euro. When I picked up the car at the airport I was told that they won't accept my mastercard debit (same card that I paid with before) for the deposit unless I get an additional comprehensive insurance that cost 618.80Euro. I urgently needed the car and they refused to give it to me unless I'd pay the additional amount plus a 250.00 Euro deposit. So I had to pay 1071.36Euro plus deposit instead of the promised 453.18Euro. I'm not the only one. It's a rip off. Check other reviews very carefully and stay away.

name: REDWILLIAM
title: They fool people
text: They fool people, first they ask litle transaction, 1 Euro if you re creditcard works, than on they you arrive they take off money and tell you cant pay!! But you already paid! You try with other cards but they dont accept it!!!Don t rent here, verry bad service and still not get money back!! Thinking of going to police!

title: Misleading yet still cheapest

title: Awful agengy that will not take any…

title: Bucks and Bunnies was Amazing!
text: Our stay at Bucks and Bunnies was amazing. The house was beautiful and the views were gorgeous. We had a wonderful spring break with no problems at all on this trip.

name: Galeana Anita
title: Cozy getaway
text: House is great! Stocked with everything you might need. Great for families! Will be returning in January of next year!

name: Kristen
title: We just stayed at “It Was All a Dream…”…
text: We just stayed at “It Was All a Dream…” in Eagles Nest and the house truly was a dream! It’s a brand new build, with four en suite bedrooms which was perfect for our family. The house is decorated in impeccable taste and is so well equipped with everything you possibly could need during your stay! The back deck is a great gathering place with a hot tub, a table for outdoor dining and a seating area around the fireplace. After a great day of enjoying the Eagles Nest amenities, coming back to “It Was All a Dream” felt like coming home. We can’t wait to visit again!

name: Tanya C.
title: Cozy Cabin
text: This cabin was perfect for an impromptu mountain getaway. It was very clean and cozy. We stay in this area frequently but this was our first time staying in this cabin. It is now one of our favorites! We will be back.

name: Brown James
title: We had a fantastic trip over four…
text: We had a fantastic trip over four nights. Beautiful scenery and our two dogs enjoyed the cabin and walks. Just driving around the community is breathtaking. We lucked out with warm skiing at Sugar and even got fresh snow while there. The views were wonderful! And the mountain community felt alive and fun to explore. Love the fields and play areas as well. Wasn't sure how to start the propane fireplace but the response was immediate.

name: Patty Hughes
title: Family reunion
text: The ease of the whole trip from start to finish was wonderful. I loved getting the updated text messages. The cabin was beautiful and clean. We also enjoyed the girl scout cookies and water. That was a very welcomed surprise.  We would definitely book this cabin again.  It had something for everyone.

name: Blake Grayson
title: Annual Family Vacation
text: My family loves renting through BRMB. It’s easy and convenient. You have the security of knowing the team is there to help if needed. There is a lot of contact between booking and time of stay. The choices of homes are amazing. Being a returning renter you get perks which is just another reason to go through BRMB.

name: customer
title: Fantastic rental company 5 stars…
text: We were so impressed with BRMR from beginning to end. The lines of communication were very informative and available. The property was beautiful and had everything and then some. Loved the area and liked knowing if we had any questions or problems it was as easy as a text away.

name: Julie
title: Had a wonderful time!
text: We enjoyed our stay…condo was well equipped as stated and very cute on the inside. The rental agency let us know several days before the fireplace wasn’t working which was not a big deal as the weather was very mild and fireplace was definitely not needed. Felt like communication was super and even texted us early to let us know the unit was available early on check in. Would definitely rent again!

name: Stempien Heather
title: Highly recommend, based on numerous interactions
text: We've rented with Blue Ridge Mountain a few times and each time the pricing has been reasonable, the process has been easy, and the property has been just as described. On this most recent visit, we wanted to extend, and that was very easy to do as well. We will continue to use them for all of our Carolina visits.

name: Coley Katherine

name: Welborn family
title: Charming spring break escape
text: Such a charming escape. Our family had a magical week here in early spring enjoying clean, comfy, light-filled rooms; the well-stocked kitchen where things were easy to find; the wrap-around porch with lovely pastoral views; and the yard's fun features, including hammock, swings, and hot tub. My husband and I worked remotely for two days--fast internet (and a great mini-office setup in one of the bedrooms) made that easy, and our kids (5 & 10) stayed occupied with books, games, puzzles, toys, and more while we worked. The weather ranged from snowy to the high 70s during the week we were there, and we were comfortable through it all (and enjoyed roasting marshmallows in the wood-burning fireplace!). This place is well situated--a convenient home base for several fantastic hikes (left notes on a few of our faves in the guest book) and meals at restaurants in the West Jefferson, Boone, and Blowing Rock area. My only regret is that it was too cold (or we were too wimpy?!?) to tube on the New River, within walking distance of the cabin. Solid reason to go back!

name: Sherri C
title: This was a very well organized tour

title: The tour

Our travel guide was exceptional - she had a way of being there for everyone.

name: Phil Schroeder
title: Touring Greece with s small group…
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and gave us more information than we could ever remember.  Each detail was taken care of for us. For anyone fearful of traveling in a foreign country, don’t be, when you have a travel company like Globus. We really enjoyed the small group tour - easy to get acquainted and build relationships.  It also enabled us to see things we couldn’t have seen with a large group. We look forward to other Globus trips!

title: Unacceptable Booking Experience – Immediate Attention Required
text: I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration regarding a recent experience that has severely impacted my trust in your platform.I booked a hotel stay through your portal, and the payment was successfully processed. It is appalling that such a lapse in coordination could occur despite a confirmed and paid booking. I have lost confidence in your service and will not be using your platform again.Please be advised that I intend to share this experience publicly to ensure others are aware of the risks involved. I urge you to investigate this matter thoroughly and provide a formal explanation and resolution at the earliest.

name: Mark
title: Scaling you to not give your money back
text: My experience with Transavia regarding the cancellation of flight TO7601 on December 28, 2024, from Porto to Paris-Orly has been extremely disappointing and frustrating.Initially, the airline stated that the cancellation was due to weather conditions. However, the reasoning behind their denial of compensation changed repeatedly over time, shifting from “weather” to ambiguous claims about “airport capacity” issues without providing any substantial evidence. Despite multiple explicit requests under EU Regulation 261/2004 for Transavia to present legally required documents (such as official NOTAMs, Air Traffic Control directives, internal operational records, or clear explanations why other flights, including another Transavia flight TO7611 from the exact same route and time frame, were able to land), they have consistently refused or failed to deliver adequate proof.Throughout my correspondence with their customer support, Transavia repeatedly attempted to direct me towards third-party intervention and mediation rather than directly fulfilling their legal obligations. Such practices clearly violate EU Regulation 261/2004, under which the burden of proof lies explicitly with the airline to demonstrate that extraordinary circumstances were genuinely unavoidable and beyond their control.Recently, Transavia has resorted to delaying tactics, repeatedly stating the case is “under review,” but providing no meaningful updates or additional information. This deliberate stalling appears to be a tactic to discourage passengers, like myself, from pursuing rightful legal claims through appropriate channels.Overall, Transavia’s handling of this issue has been marked by:•	Inconsistent and changing explanations for denial of compensation.•	Repeated refusal to provide required legal documentation.•	Unlawful insistence on third-party mediation to avoid fulfilling legal duties.•	Deliberate delays and avoidance tactics to prevent timely resolution.Due to this deeply unsatisfactory experience and their apparent disregard for passenger rights under European law, I strongly advise caution when dealing with Transavia. Future customers should be aware that resolving legitimate compensation claims may involve extensive frustration and potentially necessitate legal action.I am currently preparing legal action to enforce my rights under EU261, given Transavia’s continued refusal to comply voluntarily.

name: Ian North
title: Terrible Customer Service and Delayed Compensation – Extremely Disappointed
text: I am extremely dissatisfied with the way Transavia has handled my damaged luggage claim for flight HV6885 on November 3, 2024. Despite multiple assurances that I would receive my €1,160 refund, it’s now been four months and I have yet to see any payment or meaningful update.I was initially told that the reimbursement would be processed and transferred to my account, but it hasn’t happened. After numerous attempts to follow up and escalate the issue, I’ve been met with vague responses and constant delays. I was even told that the finance department is "working on it," but there has been no concrete update or resolution.This kind of customer service is completely unacceptable. Transavia’s lack of urgency, poor communication, and disregard for customer rights is disappointing. Under the Montreal Convention, airlines are legally obligated to compensate passengers for damaged luggage, and Transavia is clearly failing to meet this obligation. I strongly urge anyone considering flying with this airline to be cautious and be prepared for poor service and frustration if something goes wrong.I hope this issue is resolved quickly, but as of now, I’m left without a refund and a lot of frustration.

name: Ian North
title: Terrible Customer Service and Delayed Compensation – Extremely Disappointed
text: I am extremely dissatisfied with the way Transavia has handled my damaged luggage claim for flight HV6885 on November 3, 2024. Despite multiple assurances that I would receive my €1,160 refund, it’s now been four months and I have yet to see any payment or meaningful update.I was initially told that the reimbursement would be processed and transferred to my account, but it hasn’t happened. name: Mark
title: Scaling you to not give your money back
text: My experience with Transavia regarding the cancellation of flight TO7601 on December 28, 2024, from Porto to Paris-Orly has been extremely disappointing and frustrating.Initially, the airline stated that the cancellation was due to weather conditions. However, the reasoning behind their denial of compensation changed repeatedly over time, shifting from “weather” to ambiguous claims about “airport capacity” issues without providing any substantial evidence. Despite multiple explicit requests under EU Regulation 261/2004 for Transavia to present legally required documents (such as official NOTAMs, Air Traffic Control directives, internal operational records, or clear explanations why other flights, including another Transavia flight TO7611 from the exact same route and time frame, were able to land), they have consistently refused or failed to deliver adequate proof.Throughout my correspondence with their customer support, Transavia repeatedly attempted to direct me towards third-party intervention and mediation rather than directly fulfilling their legal obligations. Such practices clearly violate EU Regulation 261/2004, under which the burden of proof lies explicitly with the airline to demonstrate that extraordinary circumstances were genuinely unavoidable and beyond their control.Recently, Transavia has resorted to delaying tactics, repeatedly stating the case is “under review,” but providing no meaningful updates or additional information. This deliberate stalling appears to be a tactic to discourage passengers, like myself, from pursuing rightful legal claims through appropriate channels.Overall, Transavia’s handling of this issue has been marked by:•	Inconsistent and changing explanations for denial of compensation.•	Repeated refusal to provide required legal documentation.•	Unlawful insistence on third-party mediation to avoid fulfilling legal duties.•	Deliberate delays and avoidance tactics to prevent timely resolution.Due to this deeply unsatisfactory experience and their apparent disregard for passenger rights under European law, I strongly advise caution when dealing with Transavia. Future customers should be aware that resolving legitimate compensation claims may involve extensive frustration and potentially necessitate legal action.I am currently preparing legal action to enforce my rights under EU261, given Transavia’s continued refusal to comply voluntarily.

name: Mark
title: Scaling you to not give your money back
text: My experience with Transavia regarding the cancellation of flight TO7601 on December 28, 2024, from Porto to Paris-Orly has been extremely disappointing and frustrating.Initially, the airline stated that the cancellation was due to weather conditions. However, the reasoning behind their denial of compensation changed repeatedly over time, shifting from “weather” to ambiguous claims about “airport capacity” issues without providing any substantial evidence. Despite multiple explicit requests under EU Regulation 261/2004 for Transavia to present legally required documents (such as official NOTAMs, Air Traffic Control directives, internal operational records, or clear explanations why other flights, including another Transavia flight TO7611 from the exact same route and time frame, were able to land), they have consistently refused or failed to deliver adequate proof.Throughout my correspondence with their customer support, Transavia repeatedly attempted to direct me towards third-party intervention and mediation rather than directly fulfilling their legal obligations. Such practices clearly violate EU Regulation 261/2004, under which the burden of proof lies explicitly with the airline to demonstrate that extraordinary circumstances were genuinely unavoidable and beyond their control.Recently, Transavia has resorted to delaying tactics, repeatedly stating the case is “under review,” but providing no meaningful updates or additional information. This deliberate stalling appears to be a tactic to discourage passengers, like myself, from pursuing rightful legal claims through appropriate channels.Overall, Transavia’s handling of this issue has been marked by:•	Inconsistent and changing explanations for denial of compensation.•	Repeated refusal to provide required legal documentation.•	Unlawful insistence on third-party mediation to avoid fulfilling legal duties.•	Deliberate delays and avoidance tactics to prevent timely resolution.Due to this deeply unsatisfactory experience and their apparent disregard for passenger rights under European law, I strongly advise caution when dealing with Transavia. Future customers should be aware that resolving legitimate compensation claims may involve extensive frustration and potentially necessitate legal action.I am currently preparing legal action to enforce my rights under EU261, given Transavia’s continued refusal to comply voluntarily.

name: Maria Ac
title: Transavia is the worst! Avoid!
text: Transavia is, without a doubt, the WORST airline I have ever encountered. Their customer service is non-existent, bordering on hostile. We were left completely stranded at the airport after a flight cancellation, with absolutely zero assistance or empathy from their staff. They were rude, unhelpful, and genuinely mean.To add insult to injury, it's now been SIX MONTHS and I'm still fighting for a refund they promised! They continue to lie and give empty reassurances, with no actual money ever reaching my account. Their lack of professionalism and basic human decency is truly shameful.If you value your time, money, and sanity, DO NOT fly with Transavia. I’ve never had similar experience with any airline or customer service before and I was stunned! I hope Transavia to take these reviews seriously and review their customer service process.

name: Ian North
title: Terrible Customer Service and Delayed Compensation – Extremely Disappointed
text: I am extremely dissatisfied with the way Transavia has handled my damaged luggage claim for flight HV6885 on November 3, 2024. Despite multiple assurances that I would receive my €1,160 refund, it’s now been four months and I have yet to see any payment or meaningful update.I was initially told that the reimbursement would be processed and transferred to my account, but it hasn’t happened. After numerous attempts to follow up and escalate the issue, I’ve been met with vague responses and constant delays. I was even told that the finance department is "working on it," but there has been no concrete update or resolution.This kind of customer service is completely unacceptable. Transavia’s lack of urgency, poor communication, and disregard for customer rights is disappointing. Under the Montreal Convention, airlines are legally obligated to compensate passengers for damaged luggage, and Transavia is clearly failing to meet this obligation. I strongly urge anyone considering flying with this airline to be cautious and be prepared for poor service and frustration if something goes wrong.I hope this issue is resolved quickly, but as of now, I’m left without a refund and a lot of frustration.

name: Greg Falk
title: The Ride from Hell
text: Firstly, I did not want to award any stars for this company. No rating is more appropriate.My wife and I were booked on the Sydney-Melbourne service at 5.30 pm from Central Railway Station.It is hard to know exactly where to start with this review, given the experience.My wife visited the toilet and discovered there was no toilet paper. She had to wait for the scheduled stop at Barnawatha.Only 1 stop for food or convenience on the Syd-Melb route is unsatisfactory. The facilities at the Canberra stop (to drop off and pick up passengers only on this occasion) were closed on arrival. A stop at Yass was clearly warranted.There was no notification that our seats 6A/6B, had no overhead locker space and that the seats were troublesome to get into due to the placement of the overhead TV screen.Someone had spilt water into the aisle and onto the seat immediately in front of 6A/6B, making the aisle slippery.Bag handling - there was none. At Central, I had to crawl into the baggage space and place our two bags (my wife took a few pictures, which I intend to upload to a public website. It is certainly not a good look for a 71-year-old trying to put bags in the baggage compartment). Subsequently, the bags were moved from where they had been placed and were shoved roughly elsewhere. There was no baggage organisation whatsoever, except for a request that Canberra bags be placed on one side of the baggage compartment, and Melbourne bags on the other. In Melbourne, the process was reversed. I had to remove a number of other passengers' bags to get to our cases.I cannot recommend Greyhound under any circumstances (they are more expensive than other bus lines with clearly inferior service).

name: Helen Donald
title: Basic reliable service -great value for money
text: We booked the Flixbus from NYC to Philadelphia largely because the price one way was $20 compared to over $250 on Amtrak. The bus left and arrived exactly on time. name: Dee Ann Horinek
title: The greyhound bus from Pueblo to…
text: The greyhound bus from Pueblo to Wichita was awful the driver got off the bus to get a drink told the other passengers that they could get a drink. Then proceeded to pay for his drink and left 15 people at the store and took off with their belongings. They told them the best they could do was reschedule their bus for the next day but would not make accommodations for them.  It was 27 degrees and snowing and they mage them to sleep in an unsafe open cement parking garage. As their belongings and money and personal things were stolen by the bus driver when he drove off and left them.

name: Maarja Toom
title: Unreliable service
text: I havent used their bus service for years, but now I know why...  The bus to Brisbane was supposed to leave at 12 PM today, but they received sms saying the new time is between 12:55- 13:30, but I saw it 5 minutes before my tax arrived at the station.I called customer service and asked if they could tell me when its arriving to Brisbane so I could plan my daybut she replied she dont know the exact time, depends  blabla.Now its1:45PM and the bus hasnt arrived and someone said it will be delayed for another 15 minutes!!!!!! I been waiting since 11:50... HIGHLY UNRELIABLE service. I wouldnT recommend it to anyone who wants to be somewhere on time cause you never know its hit and miss it can be 1:30 or 16:30. Very disappointed of their servce... Probably its faster to walk to Brisbane 😃

name: RobinBlackwell
title: Greyhound was on time and the driver is…
text: Greyhound was on time and the driver is friendly.  The bus was neat and very tidy and clean .

name: Greg Falk
title: The Ride from Hell
text: Firstly, I did not want to award any stars for this company. No rating is more appropriate.My wife and I were booked on the Sydney-Melbourne service at 5.30 pm from Central Railway Station.It is hard to know exactly where to start with this review, given the experience.My wife visited the toilet and discovered there was no toilet paper. She had to wait for the scheduled stop at Barnawatha.Only 1 stop for food or convenience on the Syd-Melb route is unsatisfactory. The facilities at the Canberra stop (to drop off and pick up passengers only on this occasion) were closed on arrival. A stop at Yass was clearly warranted.There was no notification that our seats 6A/6B, had no overhead locker space and that the seats were troublesome to get into due to the placement of the overhead TV screen.Someone had spilt water into the aisle and onto the seat immediately in front of 6A/6B, making the aisle slippery.Bag handling - there was none. At Central, I had to crawl into the baggage space and place our two bags (my wife took a few pictures, which I intend to upload to a public website. It is certainly not a good look for a 71-year-old trying to put bags in the baggage compartment). Subsequently, the bags were moved from where they had been placed and were shoved roughly elsewhere. There was no baggage organisation whatsoever, except for a request that Canberra bags be placed on one side of the baggage compartment, and Melbourne bags on the other. In Melbourne, the process was reversed. I had to remove a number of other passengers' bags to get to our cases.I cannot recommend Greyhound under any circumstances (they are more expensive than other bus lines with clearly inferior service).

title: Atlanta bus station security problem!

text: Booked a hotel room in Spain with this company on 25-11-2018When i arrived at the hotel on the 25-02-2019, the hotel said there was no reservation for me.I showed them the Gala Booking booking confirmation & they said they have had trouble with this company in the past.They hotel receptionist looked into it and come back to me with printed out document Saying that there was a reservation made for me on the 25-11-2018 but that it had been cancelled on the 19-12-2018 by Gala Hotels.Gala Hotels had cancelled the booking without informing me or refunding me the £380 i had paid them.I then paid the Hotel Porta De Galleces a further 496 euros for the hotel room.I tried contacting the Gala Hotels emergency phone number +90 212 705 4858 when the matter first came to light but there was no answer.Since i got home i have again tried ringing the UK number on there web site + 44 20 3384 64 48 but it is constantly engaged.The matter is now being looked into by the credit card company i used to pay for the booking.

title: If I’m being honest it deserves …

title: AVOID Gala Hotel.

name: Finn Skrabeklev
title: Avoid this company!
text: Please avoid this company!In dec. 2018 we booked a hotel in Granada, Spain (two double rooms) through Gala hotels. We got the confirmation of the booking immediately. A few weeks later, my bank account was charged for the stay. When we arrived at the hotel the 20 of March 2019 (date for our stay), we experienced that the booking had been cancelled back in december 2018.This was just after my bank account had been charged for the stay. We had not received any information about their cancellation. Luckily we got the two rooms, but we had to pay them once again at the hotel.The same day, I sent an e-mail to Gala hotels and claimed about their cancellation and behavior. I also claimed my money back.Untill today, I have not heard a word from Gala hotels.RegardsFinn Skrabeklev, Norway

name: Stefanie
title: Cancelled booking in Bayswater Inn Hotel in London
text: I had a booking ( from March 03 to March 08, 2019) in the Bayswater Inn Hotel (7570), London, GB.I printed out the voucher which was sent via email. As I checked in with the hotel under this booking number I was told, that my reservaction was cancelled.The hotel clerk tried to call the emergency numer (+90 212 705 4858), the UK number +44 20 3384 6448, she tried to open the Galahotel homepage, I tried to open the homepage, so did my husband in Germany. Nothing worked, no response, nobody answered the phone, one phone number was disconnected. Instead we found out, that this kind of fraud happended to a lot of customers. Hotel rooms were booked, confirmation numbers for a voucher were sent via email, but when the people checked in with the hotel, the booking was cancelled. So it happened to me. I did pay 281 Euro via my Visa Card for this booking with GalaHotels and all I got was a cancelled hotel reservation. My son and I had to find another hotel, because this one was completely booked. Since I am a journalist, this is a really good story to get publish - which I will do in any case to warn people about this very mean fraud.Now I tried to file a complaint with the hotel - since all of a sudden the homepage works again - but it just gives me an error message.So please, under no circumstances book with this group any hotelrooms. The chances are pretty good, that you will have to pay for another hotel ...

title: Avoid this company!

name: Stefanie
title: Cancelled booking in Bayswater Inn Hotel in London
text: I had a booking ( from March 03 to March 08, 2019) in the Bayswater Inn Hotel (7570), London, GB.I printed out the voucher which was sent via email. As I checked in with the hotel under this booking number I was told, that my reservaction was cancelled.The hotel clerk tried to call the emergency numer (+90 212 705 4858), the UK number +44 20 3384 6448, she tried to open the Galahotel homepage, I tried to open the homepage, so did my husband in Germany. Nothing worked, no response, nobody answered the phone, one phone number was disconnected. Instead we found out, that this kind of fraud happended to a lot of customers. Hotel rooms were booked, confirmation numbers for a voucher were sent via email, but when the people checked in with the hotel, the booking was cancelled. So it happened to me. I did pay 281 Euro via my Visa Card for this booking with GalaHotels and all I got was a cancelled hotel reservation. My son and I had to find another hotel, because this one was completely booked. Since I am a journalist, this is a really good story to get publish - which I will do in any case to warn people about this very mean fraud.Now I tried to file a complaint with the hotel - since all of a sudden the homepage works again - but it just gives me an error message.So please, under no circumstances book with this group any hotelrooms. The chances are pretty good, that you will have to pay for another hotel ...

title: Avoid this company!

title: Cancelled booking in Bayswater Inn Hotel in London
text: I had a booking ( from March 03 to March 08, 2019) in the Bayswater Inn Hotel (7570), London, GB.I printed out the voucher which was sent via email. As I checked in with the hotel under this booking number I was told, that my reservaction was cancelled.The hotel clerk tried to call the emergency numer (+90 212 705 4858), the UK number +44 20 3384 6448, she tried to open the Galahotel homepage, I tried to open the homepage, so did my husband in Germany. Nothing worked, no response, nobody answered the phone, one phone number was disconnected. Instead we found out, that this kind of fraud happended to a lot of customers. Hotel rooms were booked, confirmation numbers for a voucher were sent via email, but when the people checked in with the hotel, the booking was cancelled. So it happened to me. I did pay 281 Euro via my Visa Card for this booking with GalaHotels and all I got was a cancelled hotel reservation. My son and I had to find another hotel, because this one was completely booked. Since I am a journalist, this is a really good story to get publish - which I will do in any case to warn people about this very mean fraud.Now I tried to file a complaint with the hotel - since all of a sudden the homepage works again - but it just gives me an error message.So please, under no circumstances book with this group any hotelrooms. title: Cancelled booking in Bayswater Inn Hotel in London
text: I had a booking ( from March 03 to March 08, 2019) in the Bayswater Inn Hotel (7570), London, GB.I printed out the voucher which was sent via email. As I checked in with the hotel under this booking number I was told, that my reservaction was cancelled.The hotel clerk tried to call the emergency numer (+90 212 705 4858), the UK number +44 20 3384 6448, she tried to open the Galahotel homepage, I tried to open the homepage, so did my husband in Germany. Nothing worked, no response, nobody answered the phone, one phone number was disconnected. Instead we found out, that this kind of fraud happended to a lot of customers. Hotel rooms were booked, confirmation numbers for a voucher were sent via email, but when the people checked in with the hotel, the booking was cancelled. So it happened to me. I did pay 281 Euro via my Visa Card for this booking with GalaHotels and all I got was a cancelled hotel reservation. My son and I had to find another hotel, because this one was completely booked. Since I am a journalist, this is a really good story to get publish - which I will do in any case to warn people about this very mean fraud.Now I tried to file a complaint with the hotel - since all of a sudden the homepage works again - but it just gives me an error message.So please, under no circumstances book with this group any hotelrooms. The chances are pretty good, that you will have to pay for another hotel ...

title: This company sends you back and forth…
text: This company sends you back and forth with the vendor and does nothing other than to compensate with Onekey........over an issue.I booked through "Blue Light app', it took me via Hotels.com to book for our holiday hotel stay.This was a bad choice for me.I payed excessive amount to the establishment and had misleading information to the point that I had my relative check the Hotels.com, establishment website out, we both came to the same conclusion in what we saw advertised. name: Balram Panjwani
title: Extremely Disappointing Customer…
text: Extremely Disappointing Customer Service – Hotels.com is a Huge LetdownI used to trust Hotels.com for my bookings, but after this experience, I will never book through them again. I recently had an issue with a hotel, NH Madrid Paseo de la Habana, where I was given a terrible room with broken ventilation, and to make matters worse, I had a lizard on my bed during the night. Despite paying 315 Euros per night for the room, the hotel’s staff was unhelpful, and when I tried to escalate the issue to Hotels.com, they were completely useless.The customer service from Hotels.com was incredibly disappointing. Instead of offering any meaningful support, they just passed the responsibility back to the hotel, who didn’t care about resolving the problem either. I tried to get a resolution, such as a refund or compensation, but Hotels.com simply ignored my concerns and didn't advocate for me at all. Their response made me feel completely unsupported.In contrast, Booking.com has always been much more reliable, with excellent customer service and a more customer-focused approach. I regret switching to Hotels.com and will be going back to Booking.com for all my future bookings.If you're looking for good service and support, I highly recommend Booking.com over Hotels.com. Their lack of assistance has seriously damaged my trust in their platform, and I’ll be taking my business elsewhere from now on.
