text: I had purchased a few hotels.com gift cards for a friend however the person I purchased the gift card for didn't want them so I decided to use them myself. However I found uncovering the pin to be very difficult and the last card I used i was unable to read the pin and after several attempts the card was suspended. After calling to get a replacement I was informed that if the pin is damaged the card was void and they would not replace or refund the purchase price. The representative I called aknoleged the card had a full balance. I was told to take a picture of the card and send an email to customer service. I was also informed I would receive a response in 48 hours. I was gosted and after several emails completely ignored. I would never buy a gift card from hotels com. Lesson learned.

name: NJ
title: Don't use hotels.com
text: Don't use hotels.com. They went from being the best booking service to a straight up scam. The already weak reward system is a scam. You will find out that barely any hotels are elegible to be paid with rewards points because, in their words, "most properties are already discounted". Total scam. Fraud class action!

title: AVOID

name: Balram Panjwani
title: Extremely Disappointing Customer…
text: Extremely Disappointing Customer Service – Hotels.com is a Huge LetdownI used to trust Hotels.com for my bookings, but after this experience, I will never book through them again. I recently had an issue with a hotel, NH Madrid Paseo de la Habana, where I was given a terrible room with broken ventilation, and to make matters worse, I had a lizard on my bed during the night. Despite paying 315 Euros per night for the room, the hotel’s staff was unhelpful, and when I tried to escalate the issue to Hotels.com, they were completely useless.The customer service from Hotels.com was incredibly disappointing. Instead of offering any meaningful support, they just passed the responsibility back to the hotel, who didn’t care about resolving the problem either. I tried to get a resolution, such as a refund or compensation, but Hotels.com simply ignored my concerns and didn't advocate for me at all. Their response made me feel completely unsupported.In contrast, Booking.com has always been much more reliable, with excellent customer service and a more customer-focused approach. I regret switching to Hotels.com and will be going back to Booking.com for all my future bookings.If you're looking for good service and support, I highly recommend Booking.com over Hotels.com. Their lack of assistance has seriously damaged my trust in their platform, and I’ll be taking my business elsewhere from now on.

title: We completed this trip yesterday, Glad its over.
text: We completed this trip yesterday. Glad it’s over. Our ticket said China Southern but we couldn’t check in on the app because it didn’t recognize any of our ticket numbers or codes. We arrived at the airport as suggested in your email, 4 hours before our flight time only to have to wait 2hours before the check in counter was open for our flight. When we got checked in at the airport, which took a while, I found out this airline was not part of one of my airline programs. My search said it was part of Star Alliance. But I get no points? Then, when we got on the plane we were on another airline? Szechuan Airlines.  Still don’t know how or why that happened. We had packed in carry on luggage but had to check our bags because they were too heavy. Didn’t realize carry on had a weight limit. Never had that before.On a positive note both lounges in Tokyo and TFU were very comfortable, making our 5hour layover pleasant.Cynthia’s customer service helped us complete, airline caused, change issues and phone support helped us resolve check in issues. We are grateful for this help. Wishing phone support was available on WhatsApp in the middle of our two month trip.Since this sojourn, that we are on, is the first of several we are planing,  we will have earned  some valuable experience for next time.

title: We completed this trip yesterday, Glad its over.
text: We completed this trip yesterday. Glad it’s over. Our ticket said China Southern but we couldn’t check in on the app because it didn’t recognize any of our ticket numbers or codes. We arrived at the airport as suggested in your email, 4 hours before our flight time only to have to wait 2hours before the check in counter was open for our flight. When we got checked in at the airport, which took a while, I found out this airline was not part of one of my airline programs. My search said it was part of Star Alliance. But I get no points? Then, when we got on the plane we were on another airline? Szechuan Airlines.  Still don’t know how or why that happened. We had packed in carry on luggage but had to check our bags because they were too heavy. Didn’t realize carry on had a weight limit. Never had that before.On a positive note both lounges in Tokyo and TFU were very comfortable, making our 5hour layover pleasant.Cynthia’s customer service helped us complete, airline caused, change issues and phone support helped us resolve check in issues. We are grateful for this help. Wishing phone support was available on WhatsApp in the middle of our two month trip.Since this sojourn, that we are on, is the first of several we are planing,  we will have earned  some valuable experience for next time.

title: Don't Book Through Expedia
text: Like others - would give a zero if I could.  I booked a flight from Chicago to New Zealand for my family.  We weren't able to get seats for the leg from LAX to New Zealand.  Contacted NZ Air, they said ticket information hadn't been transmitted.  Contacted United Air, they said the issue was not on their end but by the ticketing agent - Expedia.  Contacted Expedia customer service 8 times over 48 hours, endless hours on hold.  Was promised multiple times that the problem was resolved.  Contacted the number they gave me for NZ Air to select our seats, nope.  They did not have our ticketing information.  Finally gave up and booked directly through NZ Air.  Went to Expedia for a refund, they tell me the tickets are nonrefundable.   They accepted no responsibility for the ticketing fiasco.  How are tickets that were never issued nonrefundable?

title: I booked a travel package to Paris in…

Despite reaching out to Expedia multiple times with evidence, they took no responsibility and offered no support.Highly disappointed with both Expedia and Avis. This experience shows a lack of customer protection and accountability.Mahdi Alizadeh

Contacted NZ Air, they said ticket information hadn't been transmitted.  Contacted United Air, they said the issue was not on their end but by the ticketing agent - Expedia.  Contacted Expedia customer service 8 times over 48 hours, endless hours on hold.  Was promised multiple times that the problem was resolved.  Contacted the number they gave me for NZ Air to select our seats, nope.  They did not have our ticketing information.  Finally gave up and booked directly through NZ Air.  Went to Expedia for a refund, they tell me the tickets are nonrefundable.   They accepted no responsibility for the ticketing fiasco.  How are tickets that were never issued nonrefundable?

Altogether we booked the flight,hotel and rental car through Expedia, the total amount we paid was $1,354,00. When we arrived at the hotel, the amenities that were advertised online did not match the hotel room or the hotel, we reached out to the hotel staff and asked them where was the telephone,the robe s, the coffee maker, the bath towels and the staff honestly told us they do not have non of these amenities they advertised online to sell this room. The mattress was soiled with an unknown substance, the toilet kept getting stopped up and the maintenance man openly told us do not place toilet paper inside the comode after (certain) usage. We reached out to Expedia with these concerns and worries and explained to them we had pictures of the soiled mattress and the hotel room unacceptable condition. Expedia reassured us they will get to the bottom of this problem and refund us the amount for hotel which was $582.00. Expedia lied to my wife and I, they said they could not contact the hotel manager to corroborate this situation. Expedia needs to be shut down as a whole when you lie to your customers there is no future in your service or commitment i would not recommend Expedia.com to anyone on this planet stay away from this company.

name: Ken
title: Don't Book Through Expedia
text: Like others - would give a zero if I could.  I booked a flight from Chicago to New Zealand for my family.  We weren't able to get seats for the leg from LAX to New Zealand.  Contacted NZ Air, they said ticket information hadn't been transmitted.  Contacted United Air, they said the issue was not on their end but by the ticketing agent - Expedia.  Contacted Expedia customer service 8 times over 48 hours, endless hours on hold.  Was promised multiple times that the problem was resolved.  Contacted the number they gave me for NZ Air to select our seats, nope.  They did not have our ticketing information.  Finally gave up and booked directly through NZ Air.  Went to Expedia for a refund, they tell me the tickets are nonrefundable.   They accepted no responsibility for the ticketing fiasco.  How are tickets that were never issued nonrefundable?

name: Consumer
title: I booked a travel package to Paris in…
text: I booked a travel package to Paris in March through Expedia, including a rental car from Avis. The vehicle I reserved was not available, and I was forced to accept a larger, less efficient car. Avis also charged me for battery recharge, despite the car being delivered with less than full charge — which I documented with photos.Additionally, they imposed a large fee for a very minor scratch that was clearly pre-existing. Despite reaching out to Expedia multiple times with evidence, they took no responsibility and offered no support.Highly disappointed with both Expedia and Avis. This experience shows a lack of customer protection and accountability.Mahdi Alizadeh

name: Carlo
title: Horrible Service. Incorrect Booking
text: please save yourself the hassle and do not use Expedia to book your travels.My first time flying with young kids and decided to try Expedia. booked a vacation package and chose to fly with Air Transat. I decided to book premium economy seats (Club) for the extra space for the kids. Went through the entire booking process on Expedia.ca. Paid for the trip on Expedia and shortly after I received my confirmation emails showing the roundtrip flights were budget economy. I spent a week trying to get an answer through Expedia's customer service...ended up speaking multiple people and each conversation ended with them telling me to send them an email explaining what the problem was and with screenshots; which is exactly what I did. I did not receive any replies from any of the emails. Each representative I spoke to even acknowledged the glitch in their system, but yet still tugged me along providing false hope that they can do something about it. The tickets are now nonrefundable and according to Air Transat you cannot modify Eco Budget tickets.Even if Expedia told me up front that there was nothing that they can do, I would have looked at other alternatives sooner.

name: FRANK CHESTER
title: Bait and switch!!On May 7 2025 access…
text: Bait and switch!!On May 7 2025 access Expedia.com to book a flight I found a date destinations to and from and the price was listed at 1,074 at the top of the page. The flights that were shown were $1733 per person round-trip. The return trip flight was an additional cost on top of 1733. I immediately called expedited.com on the phone spoke to representative gave all my travel information and he advises me that the exact same flight to and from was $3188 round-trip per person. I explained to him that I saw the information or attempted to book it online and he just kept talking about what it’s Christmas that’s why the prices are higher the dates where were the same dates online he kept paying oh well it’s just Christmas. I immediately went directly to another airline and paid $3100 round-trip for two people on the same travel dates. We never do business with expedia.com again!!!
